items.title: 美股壞消息不斷卻「越漲越勇」！資金湧入半導體、高收益債與比特幣
paras: 半導體股重挫、公債殖利率居高不下、地緣政治風險未解，華爾街近來壞消息不斷，但資金流向說的卻是完全不同的故事。美股創新高之際，資金同步湧入高收益債與比特幣 ETF，推升美銀牛熊指標至 2021 年以來高點，市場情緒明顯升溫。
上週，標普 500 指數改寫歷史新高，那斯達克 100 指數繳出近兩個月最亮眼的單週表現；同一時間，高收益債券基金單週吸金達 40 億美元、創下近兩年新高，比特幣相關 ETF 五個交易日內也淨流入 5 億美元。
美銀「牛熊指標」隨之攀升至 2021 年以來的最高點，顯示市場情緒已明顯轉向樂觀。
這波樂觀情緒，正好發生在一場戲劇性事件之後。由有「矽谷股神」之稱的 Leopold Aschenbrenner 所創立的 AI 主題避險基金 Situational Awareness 爆倉，一度將費城半導體指數自六月高點拖低 29%。
然而市場並未如過往般選擇避險撤退，反倒把這場動盪當成進場訊號。短短兩個交易日內，每日 3 倍看多半導體 ETF(SOXL-US) 便湧入逾 20 億美元資金，隨後七個交易日累計漲幅超過 50%。
兩檔規模最大的非槓桿半導體 ETF 同期也合計吸金逾 70 億美元，各自上漲約 16%。整體而言，半導體相關槓桿與非槓桿基金上週合計吸引超過 110 億美元資金。
JonesTrading 首席市場策略師 Michael O"Rourke 將這股買氣形容為動能買盤掀起的「海嘯」，但他也提醒，不少資金依然集中在市值最大的幾檔科技股上，真正撐起指數漲勢的主力仍是七巨頭。

從股市到債市、加密貨幣，風險偏好全面回溫

分析人士指出，推升行情的不只是晶片股，而是跨資產類別的全面資金涌入。
根據美銀統計，高收益債券基金上週淨流入 40 億美元，創下兩年來單週新高；比特幣 ETF 儘管幣價已橫盤數月，五個交易日內仍吸金 5 億美元。
美銀牛熊指標因此升至 2021 年來高點，策略師 Michael Hartnett 團隊的分析指出，漲勢已從科技股核心板塊擴散開來，加上高收益債資金強勁、信用利差收窄，共同撐起了這股樂觀氛圍。
Natixis Investment Managers Solutions 投資組合策略師 Garrett Melson 則認為，眼下市場的疑慮被過度放大，風險資產基本面其實穩固。
他目前維持美股超配、聚焦大型科技股的部位，固定收益則相對低配。
Melson 強調，整體經濟表現依然良好，情緒與部位有時會過度延伸，但這種過熱只是局部現象, 類股輪動反而有助於消化泡沫、同時支撐大盤。

殖利率仍居高不下，成為最大隱憂

不過這場多頭盛宴並非毫無陰影。30 年期美債殖利率雖然近五個交易日有四天回落，但仍徘徊在近二十年高點附近，成為市場揮之不去的壓力來源。
至於殖利率為何居高不下，市場看法分歧。
一派認為 7 月底的飆升，是因為聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）未能給出明確的利率指引，讓外界對其抗通膨決心產生疑慮；另一派則認為，這其實反映投資人對經濟持續擴張的信心。
上週五公布的美國 7 月就業數據意外轉弱，加上前兩月數據下修，反而提振了股市、壓低了殖利率，市場因此押注聯準會短期內不至於被迫升息。
高盛資產管理的 Lindsay Rosner 指出，隨著數據逐漸明朗、油價趨穩，經濟全貌以及資本支出的回報率也變得更清晰，整體經濟依然強勁，市場正在消化 AI 相關的供給變化。
Wealth Enhancement 資深投資策略師 Ayako Yoshioka 則提醒，半導體雖仍是 AI 基礎建設的核心，但接下來的瓶頸恐怕會轉移到電力供應不足，而殖利率走高本身，仍是必須留意的風險。

每次回調都被視為買點，多頭信心愈戰愈強

分析指出，支撐這波風險偏好的，還有一種在市場上一再被驗證的心理慣性，即每次拉回都很短暫，每次恐慌都是進場機會。
Manulife Investment Management 資深投資組合經理 Nathan Thooft 觀察到，價格修正一再證明只是曇花一現，這種經驗不斷強化投資人的信心；反倒是在不確定性最高時選擇出場的人，往往錯過隨後最強勁的反彈。
Thooft 直言，現金雖然感覺安全，長期卻難以跑贏通膨與股市的獲利成長。他認為過去十年，那些一直等待更理想進場時機的投資人，大多已被市場拋在後頭。
市場情緒的快速修復，也反映在波動率指標上。芝加哥選擇權交易所（Cboe）半導體 ETF 波動率指數本週下滑近 9 個點，創下今年最大單週跌幅。儘管風險清單仍在拉長，但資金的實際流向，顯然仍指向風險資產。

items.title: SK海力士單周大跌15%！里昂證券：最壞情況已過 股東回報更清晰 維持「跑贏大盤」評等
items.title_en: SK Hynix Plunges 15% in a Week! CLSA: The Worst-Case Scenario Has Passed, Shareholder Returns Become Clearer, Maintaining "Outperform the Market" Rating
paras: 里昂證券 (CLSA) 出具最新報告指出，SK 海力士上週五 (7 日) 盤後宣布積極檢討強化股東價值措施，並將於第三季內公布細節，此舉直接回應市場對其今年次季財報會議「缺乏明確資本配置指引」的不滿，而這正是近期股價偏弱的主因之一。
里昂認為，受惠 AI 伺服器帶動 HBM 出貨，到 2028 年，SK 海力士獲利能力與自由現金流將維持極強勁狀態，今年股東回報規模有望突破 100 兆韓元 (含分紅與回購)，規模較往年大幅躍升，不僅實質增厚股東價值，更可能成為股價重估的催化劑。
因此，里昂維持對 SK 海力士「高度確信跑贏大盤」評級，目標價 370 萬韓元不變。
針對近期市場對「SK 海力士與輝達 HBM4 價格談判 ASP 漲幅恐落後同業」的疑慮，里昂反向解讀指出，SK 海力士 HBM4 的核心晶粒與基底晶粒部分採舊製程生產，成本結構顯著低於對手，即便最終成交價低於市場預期，毛利率仍有望優於同業，保住 HBM 龍頭的獲利護城河。
里昂在報告中也指出，在 AI 資本支出週期未歇、HBM4 量產放量的背景下，SK 海力士正從「週期股」切換至「高現金回報成長股」敘事，待今年第三季股東回報方案落地，估值壓制可望鬆動。市場短期糾結於定價邊際放緩，但里昂看的是該公司 2026–2028 年自由現金流兌現以及資本返還的雙重確定性。
paras_en: CLSA has released its latest report, stating that SK Hynix announced on Friday (7th) after the market close that it will actively review and strengthen shareholder value measures, with details to be disclosed in the third quarter. This move directly responds to market dissatisfaction with the lack of clear capital allocation guidance at its annual general meeting this year, which is one of the main reasons for the recent weakness in stock prices.

CLSA believes that, driven by AI server-driven HBM shipments, SK Hynix's profitability and free cash flow will remain extremely strong until 2028. This year's shareholder returns are expected to exceed 100 trillion KRW (including dividends and buybacks), a significant increase from previous years, not only increasing shareholder value but also potentially becoming a catalyst for revaluation.
Therefore, CLSA maintains its "highly confident outperform the market" rating for SK Hynix, with a target price of 370 million KRW unchanged.

In response to market concerns about "SK Hynix's HBM4 price negotiations with Micron and the ASP increase may lag behind the industry", CLSA reverses the interpretation, pointing out that SK Hynix's HBM4 core particles and base particles are produced using an old process, resulting in a significantly lower cost structure than its competitors. Even if the final transaction price is lower than expected, the gross margin is expected to be higher than the industry average, preserving the profitability moat of HBM leader.

CLSA also pointed out in the report that, in the background of AI capital expenditures not yet subsiding and HBM4 mass production, SK Hynix is transitioning from a "cyclical stock" to a "high cash return growth stock" narrative. As the shareholder return scheme is expected to be implemented in the third quarter, the valuation pressure is expected to ease. While the market is short-term entangled in the pricing margin slowdown, CLSA looks at the company's 2026-2028 free cash flow realization and capital return certainty.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉藥華藥與AOP部分仲裁判賠近億歐元 無懼利空消息觸及漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Yuyue Pharmaceutical and AOP Partial Arbitration Ruling: NT$36 Billion in Damages, Undaunted by Profit Warning
paras: 藥華藥周六 (8 日) 召開重訊記者會，說明與 AOP 仲裁案第二階段部分仲裁判斷，仲裁庭認定藥華藥需支付 AOP 約 9748 萬歐元 (約新台幣 36 億元)，不過藥華藥營收規模已穩健，2025 年營收達 156 億元、累計今年前 7 月營收近 145 億元，對財務無重大影響，藥華藥今 (10) 日抗空，一度觸及漲停但未鎖住。
藥華藥今天早盤 1200 元開低，不過盤中翻紅走揚，一度觸及漲停價 1360 元，不過未鎖住，截至 11 點 10 分，股價暫報 1340 元，漲幅超過 8%，成交量超過 3000 張。
藥華藥說明，此次仲裁庭認定，藥華藥延遲取得歐洲藥證及延遲供貨爭議，與 AOP 積欠的貨款與權利金約 1700 萬歐元相抵後，藥華藥需支付約 6588 萬 1114.27 歐元 (約新台幣 24.52 億元)，加上藥品採購價格爭議，藥華藥需退還 3160 萬 1477.5 歐元 (約新台幣 11.76 億元)，合計判賠約 9748 萬 2580.77 歐元 (約新台幣 36.28 億元)。
藥華藥強調，近年公司營收規模持續擴大，2025 年營收達 156 億元、累計今年前 7 月營收近 145 億元，對公司營運與財務無重大影響，且針對此案的應對措施，將研擬撤銷仲裁判斷事宜。
藥華藥 7 月營收 25.07 億元，月增 7.47%，年增 92.59%，續創單月歷史新高；累計今年前 7 月營收 144.84 億元，年增 77.46%。
paras_en: Yuyue Pharmaceutical held a press conference on Saturday (8th) to explain the second-stage partial arbitration ruling in the arbitration case with AOP. The arbitration court ruled that Yuyue Pharmaceutical must pay AOP approximately NT$3.6 billion, but Yuyue Pharmaceutical's revenue scale has been stable, with NT$156 billion in revenue in 2025 and NT$145 billion in revenue for the first seven months of this year, with no significant impact on its finances. Yuyue Pharmaceutical rose to NT$1200 today (10th) and briefly touched the limit-up price of NT$1360, but failed to lock it in.

Yuyue Pharmaceutical's stock price opened at NT$1200 today, but turned red and rose during the session, briefly touching the limit-up price of NT$1360, but failing to lock it in. As of 11:10, the stock price was NT$1340, with a gain of over 8% and a trading volume of over 3000 shares.

Yuyue Pharmaceutical explained that the arbitration court ruled that Yuyue Pharmaceutical's delay in obtaining European pharmaceutical certificates and delay in supplying goods was a controversy with AOP's overdue payment and royalty of approximately NT$170 million, which was offset by Yuyue Pharmaceutical's payment of approximately NT$6588 million 1114.27 euros (approximately NT$24.52 billion), plus the controversy over the price of pharmaceuticals, Yuyue Pharmaceutical must refund NT$3160 million 1477.5 euros (approximately NT$11.76 billion), totaling approximately NT$9748 million 2580.77 euros (approximately NT$36.28 billion) in damages.

Yuyue Pharmaceutical emphasized that the company's revenue scale has continued to expand in recent years, with NT$156 billion in revenue in 2025 and NT$145 billion in revenue for the first seven months of this year, with no significant impact on the company's operations and finances. The company will also research and prepare to revoke the arbitration ruling.

Yuyue Pharmaceutical's July revenue was NT$2.507 billion, with a monthly increase of 7.47% and a year-on-year increase of 92.59%, setting a new single-month record. The company's cumulative revenue for the first seven months of this year was NT$144.84 billion, with a year-on-year increase of 77.46%.

items.title: 砸1兆日元！索尼傳攜手台積電日本建廠 攻機器人、車用次世代感測器
items.title_en: Sony and TSMC to Invest ¥1 Trillion in Japan Factory for Robots and Next-Gen Sensors
paras: 彭博引述消息人士報導，索尼 (SONY-US) 與台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 正針對在日本合資建廠一案進行協商，雙方預計將共同斥資達 1 兆日元（約 64 億美元）。
消息人士表示，索尼旗下半導體事業「索尼半導體解決方案公司」將與台積電攜手合作，鎖定車用與機器人領域，共同開發次世代影像感測器。對此，索尼與台積電均未回應置評請求。
這項正在討論中的投資計畫，此前已由《日本經濟新聞》報導。這也是索尼影像感測器業務朝向「輕資產化」策略轉型的最新布局。近年來，索尼逐步將更多資源投入音樂發行權、電影內容以及遊戲 IP 等智慧財產領域。
消息公布後，索尼股價週一 (10 日) 早盤一度上漲 2.2%，台積電股價也上漲 1.7%。
報導稱，該合資計畫將落腳於日本九州熊本縣，亦即台積電日本晶圓廠的所在地。雙方先前曾表示，若能進一步獲得日本政府的政策補貼與支持，未來不排除擴大廠區規模。
索尼雖僅為台積電熊本廠的少數股東，但在此次新成立的合資公司中，索尼將取得主導權成為控股大股東。
總部位於東京的索尼，長期以來穩居蘋果 (AAPL-US) 、華為與三星電子 (005930KS) 等指標大廠的高階影像感測器主力供應商。近期，該公司更積極拓展業務版圖，力拚將感測元件技術延伸至車載應用與機器人等新興市場。
paras_en: Sony Corp (SONY-US) and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (2330-TW)(TSM-US) are in talks to jointly build a factory in Japan, with the two companies expected to invest a combined ¥1 trillion ($7.9 billion), according to people familiar with the matter.

The two companies plan to collaborate on developing next-generation image sensors for the automotive and robotics markets through Sony's semiconductor unit, Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corp, the people said. Sony and TSMC declined to comment on the matter.

The investment plan, which was previously reported by the Nikkei newspaper, is part of Sony's strategy to shift its image sensor business towards a 'light asset' approach. In recent years, Sony has been investing more resources in music publishing rights, film content, and gaming IP.
Sony's shares rose 2.2% in early trading on Monday, while TSMC's shares gained 1.7% after the news was reported.

The joint venture is expected to be located in Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, where TSMC has a chip factory. The two companies have previously said they would consider expanding the factory's scale if they receive policy support from the Japanese government.
Sony, which owns a small stake in TSMC's Kumamoto factory, will become the majority shareholder of the new joint venture, giving it control over the company.

Sony, based in Tokyo, has long been a major supplier of high-end image sensors to companies like Apple Inc (AAPL-US), Huawei Technologies Co and Samsung Electronics Co (005930KS). The company has been actively expanding its business into new areas, including automotive and robotics applications.

items.title: 力士7月營收創四年高 下半年營運穩步回升
items.title_en: Powerchip Sees Record Revenue in July, Expects Stable Growth in Second Half
paras: MOSFET 廠力士 (4923-TW) 7 月營收達 1.2 億元，月增 19.94%，年增 49.73%，公司表示，受惠 IDM 大廠訂單外溢，加上公司擴大供應鏈布局，帶動 7 月營收創下四年來新高，展望下半年，除了低軌衛星 (LEO) 接收器產品將在下半年陸續導入，也推出 AI 邊緣伺服器用的功率元件，可望進一步挹注營運動能。
力士指出，由於國際 IDM 大廠持續將產能轉向 AI 相關高毛利產品，帶動低、中壓 MOSFET 訂單外溢，公司也持續擴大供應鏈認證、提升產品滲透率，即使整體消費性電子市場受到記憶體供應吃緊影響，終端需求成長趨緩，力士仍憑藉多元產品布局與客戶導入效益，繳出單月營收創新高佳績。
力士表示，近期上游原物料成本持續攀升，國際半導體大廠已陸續啟動價格調整，公司亦自第二季起逐步反映成本變化、調整產品售價，以降低原物料上漲對營運造成的影響，並維持整體獲利能力。
獲利表現方面，力士上半年營收達新台幣 5.15 億元，較去年同期成長 26.43%，毛利率提升至 28%，主要係因營收規模擴大及產品組合持續優化，帶動毛利率較去年同期明顯改善，營業利益 124.6 萬元，且在業外費用控制得宜下，稅後淨利 1,669.8 萬元，每股稅後盈餘 (EPS)0.5 元，較去年表現由虧轉盈，顯示營運體質持續改善、獲利能力穩步提升。
產品布局方面，力士持續擴大電源供應器應用領域，除既有筆電 / PC 產品外，遊戲機相關產品已正式開始量產交貨，低軌衛星 (LEO) 接收器產品亦可望於下半年陸續導入，進一步挹注營運動能。
因應 AI 應用快速發展，力士亦持續投入新產品研發，目前已針對小型 AI 邊緣伺服器推出符合市場需求的 MOSFET 產品，包括散熱風扇、熱插拔 (Hot Swap) 等電源管理應用，現階段正透過既有合作系統廠進行送樣與認證，未來可望隨 AI 邊緣運算與小型 AI 伺服器市場規模擴大，逐步貢獻營收。
在電池應用方面，力士已取得多家國內外大廠認證，產品應用涵蓋無人機、伺服器備援電池 (BBU) 等領域，並持續投入新產品設計與客戶導入，積極拓展終端應用版圖，掌握 AI、高效能運算及新能源市場帶來的新商機。
展望 2026，力士表示，隨著預訂代工產能將自下半年起陸續到位，可望有效滿足客戶持續增加的訂單需求，搭配 AI 帶動 MOSFET 市場需求升溫、訂單外溢與新應用產品陸續放量，以及產品組合持續朝高附加價值方向優化，公司對下半年營運維持審慎樂觀看法，預期營收與獲利表現將逐季增溫，並持續提升產品競爭力與市場滲透率，為全年營運成長挹注穩健動能。
paras_en: Powerchip (4923-TW) reported a record revenue of NT$1.2 billion in July, up 19.94% from the previous month and 49.73% from the same period last year. The company attributed the growth to increased orders from IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) companies and its expanded supply chain layout.

Powerchip noted that IDM companies have been shifting their production capacity to AI-related high-margin products, leading to an increase in low- and medium-pressure MOSFET orders. The company has been expanding its supply chain certification and improving product penetration, despite the overall consumer electronics market being affected by memory supply constraints.

Powerchip stated that recent upstream raw material costs have continued to rise, and international semiconductor companies have begun to implement price adjustments. The company has reflected these cost changes and adjusted product prices since the second quarter to mitigate the impact on operations and maintain overall profitability.

In terms of profitability, Powerchip's first-half revenue reached NT$5.15 billion, a 26.43% increase from the same period last year. Gross margin improved to 28%, mainly due to increased revenue scale and optimized product mix. Operating income was NT$1.246 million, and net income after tax was NT$16.698 million, with EPS of NT$0.5, a significant improvement from last year's loss.

In terms of product layout, Powerchip has expanded its power supply application domain, including notebook/PC products, gaming-related products, and low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite receiver products, which are expected to be introduced in the second half.

To address the rapid development of AI applications, Powerchip has continued to invest in new product development, including MOSFET products for small AI edge servers, such as heat sinks, hot-swappable power management applications, and other products. These products are currently being sampled and certified through existing cooperation systems and are expected to contribute to revenue growth as the AI edge computing and small AI server markets expand.

In the battery application area, Powerchip has obtained certifications from multiple domestic and foreign major companies, covering applications such as drones, server backup batteries (BBU), and other areas. The company continues to invest in new product design and customer introduction, actively expanding its terminal application territory and seizing new business opportunities in AI, high-performance computing, and new energy markets.

Looking ahead to 2026, Powerchip expects to see a significant increase in demand for its products, driven by the introduction of new applications, such as AI-powered MOSFET products, and the expansion of its product portfolio to high-value-added products. The company maintains a cautious optimism for the second half, expecting revenue and profitability to increase quarter by quarter and continue to improve its product competitiveness and market penetration.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉美國飛彈庫存告急 00965強勢漲逾2%飆新高
items.title_en: Focus Stock: US Missile Inventory in Crisis, 00965 Surges Over 2% to New High
paras: 全球國防財報公布進入收官階段，美國 AI 國防軟體與國安科技獲利爆發，加上盤面浮上美國飛彈庫存吃緊利多，帶動元大航太防衛科技 (00965-TW) 今 (10) 日開盤跳漲逾 2%，股價重返新高。
在美伊衝突曠日廢時下，美國全球防衛面臨防空飛彈庫存快速減少處境，據華府智庫估計，愛國者飛彈庫存較開戰前減少 65%；華盛頓郵報報導，美國國防部副部長日前已致函國防產業，要求加快交付時程與提升產能。
而根據美國戰略暨國際研究中心資料，因高消耗而進入生產高峰的不僅愛國者，還包括薩德飛彈與精準打擊飛彈。主要生產商洛克希德馬丁 (Lockheed Martin) 近一月股價上漲 13.5%。
涵蓋歐美亞太國防供應鏈的元大航太防衛科技 (00965-TW)，10 日股價順勢飆漲，盤中刷下 27.2 元新高，近一周股價勁揚 7.4%。7 月全球股市震盪以來，00965 保持上漲 7.4%，優於大型科技指數包括費城半導體指數下跌 13.3%。
法人指出，目前全球股市的 AI 及國防兩大題材，兩者背後均包含對主導未來世界格局的地位追求，資金投入所帶動的結構性成長不容小覷。國防部分，美國 AI 國防軟體龍頭 Palantir 第二季美國政府業務年增 90%，商用業務受 AI 平台驅動年增 149%，近一月股價重新發動，大漲 33.3%。
法人表示，全球國防產業具備明確的政策與訂單支撐，難出現供過於求的失衡情形，相對科技股較無景氣循環益率。隨著各國持續推進新年度國防預算立法程序，在政策面、財務面等消息釋出之際，將有助強化全球軍工國防股延續上漲動能，建議投資人可趁勢布局。

paras_en: The global defense industry report has entered the final stage, with AI defense software and national security technology in the US experiencing a surge in profits, combined with the bullish sentiment of tight US missile inventory, driving Meta Aviation Defense Technology (00965-TW) to surge over 2% today, returning to a new high.

In the absence of a US-Iran conflict, the US global defense is facing a situation of rapid depletion of air defense missile inventory, with estimates from Washington think tanks indicating that the Patriot missile inventory has decreased by 65% since the start of the conflict; The Washington Post reported that the US Deputy Secretary of Defense has recently written to the defense industry, requesting accelerated delivery schedules and increased production capacity.

According to data from the US Strategic and International Studies Center, not only the Patriot missile, but also the Sade missile and the Precision Strike Missile have entered a production peak due to high consumption. The main manufacturer, Lockheed Martin, has seen its stock price rise by 13.5% in the past month.

Meta Aviation Defense Technology (00965-TW), which covers the defense supply chain of Europe, America, and the Asia-Pacific, surged in price on the 10th, brushing a new high of 27.2 yuan, with a strong rise of 7.4% in the past week. Since the global stock market volatility in July, 00965 has maintained an increase of 7.4%, outperforming major technology indices, including the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, which fell 13.3%.

Experts point out that the current global stock market's two major themes, AI and defense, both contain the pursuit of a leading position in shaping the future world order, and the structural growth driven by capital investment cannot be underestimated. In the defense sector, the US AI defense software leader Palantir saw its US government business increase by 90% in the second quarter, and its commercial business driven by the AI platform increased by 149% in the year, with its stock price rebounding strongly, rising by 33.3% in the past month.

Experts note that the global defense industry has clear policies and order support, making it difficult to appear in a situation of oversupply, unlike technology stocks, which have a lower cyclical yield rate. As various countries continue to push forward the legislative process for next year's defense budget, the release of policy and financial information will help strengthen the continuation of the upward momentum of global military-industrial defense stocks, suggesting that investors can take advantage of the situation to layout.

items.title: 〈房產〉卡位台積電、輝達概念國小 以桃園新設校數量居冠也有低門檻卡位區
items.title_en: Taipei and Taoyuan Top the List for New Elementary Schools with Affordable Housing Options
paras: 少子化浪潮下，六都還是陸續規劃了 9 所新小學。房仲業者統計六都今年起新設立的 9 所國小周邊住宅實價行情，其中以台北市的洲美國小周邊房價最高，預售屋均價每坪 123.8 萬元，中古屋每坪均價 75.7 萬元，都是 9 所新校中之冠。
而桃園市的龍科國小，預售屋均價 31 萬元，中古屋均價 21.5 萬元，則是新設國小當中，卡位單價門檻最親民的學校。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心執行長張旭嵐表示，少子化趨勢下，許多學校都在減班、併校，而六都新設立國小，大致可歸納為三種型態。首先是「園區展望型」，因學校位於產業園區方圓 1 公里內，近年受 AI 帶動，園區附近的就業、居住與就學需求提高，催生新校設立。
其中北士科內的洲美國小，在輝達海外總部拍板北士科後，被戲稱為「輝達國小」，桃園市龍潭區的龍科國小、高雄楠梓的藍田國小也因鄰近台積電 (2330-TW) 廠區，成為「台積概念國小」；林口的力行國小附近亦有新北國際 AI + 園區加持；大園區的航科國小則坐落客運園區，與大園產業園區、觀音產業園區也相距不遠，凸顯產業發展與人口剛需的緊密連結。
另一種為「軌道加持型」，區段受軌道發展帶動，吸引人口移居周邊新興重劃區，比如台中北屯的南興國小鄰近台鐵與中捷綠線共站的松竹站，加上所在的單元十二重劃區新案完工後，人口增速快，使地方政府積極籌建公共建設；烏日的旭光國小更位處台中唯一三鐵共構的烏日高鐵特區，區段後續還不乏大型住商開發案推動發展，房市前景備受關注。
另外有「重劃成熟型」，包括平鎮南勢重劃區的平鎮國小，以及中壢過嶺重劃區的過嶺國小，因重劃區開發至今超過 10 年，已脫離草創階段，邁入穩定長人時期，使區段的剛性需求相對厚實，周邊住宅市場及學區價值也同步提升。
張旭嵐指出，新設立的國小，常結合雙語教學、實驗教學等精緻化教育且招生初期學生人數少，也更容易獲得教學資源，使新學校的學區宅在市場上頗受歡迎。不過在學校周邊購屋，並非進入目標學校就讀的保證，各縣市教育局會依招生人數及學區人口變化，於正式招生前公告最新學區範圍，部分熱門學校甚至需提早多年設籍，因此家長購屋前，除評估房價與生活機能外，也應先確認最新學區劃分及設籍規定，避免因學區調整影響就學權益。
全台六都新設立的 9 所學校，桃園市獨佔 4 所，是未來 10 年內新設國小最多的都會，反映桃園市近年強勁的人口成長動能，僅僅今年上半年，桃園市就淨遷入將近 4000 人，人口成長數高居全台第一。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心資深經理陳定中表示，桃園受惠航空城計畫、捷運路網延伸及首都圈內相對親民的房價，持續吸引年輕家庭移居，也使過嶺重劃區、大園客運園區等新興發展區的住宅需求增加，必須同步擴充教育資源，因此成為六都中新設國小最密集的城市。
陳定中指出，由於各國小周邊的房價結構不同，往往使想爭取設籍時間又想兼顧購屋預算的家長傷透腦筋。台北市洲美國小周邊的新舊屋價差大，中古屋價格遠比新案平實，也有助於立即設籍，是卡位學區相對有利的選擇。而桃園的過嶺國小、航科國小及龍科國小，位處新開發區段，新舊屋屋齡差距不大，預售屋與中古屋每坪價差僅約 6- 10 萬元，在預算允許下，可優先選擇新屋，以兼顧居住品質與未來保值性。
paras_en: In the face of the declining birth rate, the six municipalities have continued to plan for 9 new elementary schools. Real estate agents have compiled data on the new elementary schools in the six municipalities, with Taipei's Zhongshan Elementary School having the highest housing prices. The average price of pre-sale houses is NT$1,238,000 per ping, and the average price of old houses is NT$75,700 per ping, making it the top school among the 9 new schools.

Taoyuan's Longguo Elementary School has the lowest threshold for new house prices, with an average price of NT$310,000 per ping, and an average price of NT$21,500 per ping for old houses, making it the most affordable school among the new schools.

Taiwan Real Estate Group Trend Center Executive Director Zhang Xuruilan pointed out that in the face of the declining birth rate, many schools have reduced classes and merged schools. The new elementary schools in the six municipalities can be roughly categorized into three types. The first type is the 'park zone prospect type', where the school is located within a 1-kilometer radius of an industrial park. In recent years, the park has been driven by AI, and the demand for employment, residence, and education has increased, giving birth to the establishment of new schools.

Among them, North Zhongshan Elementary School in Beitou, Taipei, was nicknamed 'Huadai Elementary School' after Huadai Overseas Headquarters decided to set up a branch in Beitou. Taoyuan's Longtan District's Longguo Elementary School, Kaohsiung's Lantian Elementary School, and Lin Kou's Lixing Elementary School are all located near the TSMC (2330-TW) factory zone, making them 'TSMC concept elementary schools'.

The second type is the 'railway support type', where the area is driven by railway development, attracting population to move to new emerging redevelopment areas. For example, Taichung's Nanxing Elementary School is located near the Taichung Railway Station and the Taichung Metro Green Line, and after the completion of the single unit 12 redevelopment area, the population grew rapidly, prompting the local government to actively plan for public construction.

The third type is the 'redevelopment mature type', including Pingzhen's Pingzhen Elementary School and Zhongli's Guoli Elementary School, which have been developed for over 10 years and have entered a stable long-term period, making the area's rigid demand relatively strong, and the surrounding residential market and school district values have also risen synchronously.

Zhang Xuruilan pointed out that new elementary schools often combine bilingual education, experimental education, and other refined education, and the initial number of students is small, making it easier to obtain teaching resources, making the new school's school district a popular choice in the market. However, purchasing a house near the school does not guarantee admission to the school, and the local education department will announce the latest school district boundaries and enrollment requirements before formal enrollment.

Among the 9 new schools in the six municipalities, Taoyuan has 4 schools, making it the city with the most new elementary schools in the next 10 years. This reflects Taoyuan's strong population growth momentum in recent years, with nearly 4,000 people moving in during the first half of the year, making it the city with the highest population growth rate in Taiwan.

Taiwan Real Estate Group Trend Center Senior Manager Chen Dingzhong pointed out that Taoyuan has benefited from the Aviation City Plan, the extension of the subway network, and the relatively affordable housing prices in the capital circle, attracting young families to move in, and increasing the demand for residential housing in emerging development areas such as the Overpass Redevelopment Area and the Daan Bus Station Area.

Chen Dingzhong pointed out that due to the different housing price structures around each elementary school, parents who want to secure a seat in the school but also want to consider their budget are often at a loss. Taipei's Zhongshan Elementary School has a large price difference between new and old houses, with old house prices far more affordable than new houses, making it a relatively advantageous choice for securing a seat in the school. In Taoyuan, the Overpass Elementary School, the Aviation Elementary School, and the Longguo Elementary School are located in newly developed areas, with a relatively small price difference between new and old houses, making it possible to choose new houses within budget to balance living quality and future appreciation.

items.title: iPhone 17要漲價了？傳蘋果最快8/10調高售價、記憶體成本飆升成關鍵
items.title_en: iPhone 17 May See Price Hike: Apple to Raise Prices as Early as August 10, Memory Costs Soar
paras: 根據最新傳聞，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 最快可能在本週一（10 日）調高 iPhone 17 售價，時間點甚至早於外界預期的下一波漲價，而更大規模的價格調整則預計將伴隨下月 iPhone 18 Pro 上市登場。
根據《MacRumors》報導，微博爆料帳號「Fixed Focus Digital」昨日發文表示，市場目前流傳 iPhone 17 將於 10 日起調整價格的消息。
不過，該爆料者並未明確表示價格是否真的會上調；相較之下，貼文較為確定地指出，蘋果已取消部分生產線將產能由原本增加 15% 至 30% 的計畫。
目前尚不清楚該貼文所指的產能調整，具體涉及哪些零組件或產品。
基於記憶體與儲存元件成本大幅上升，蘋果今年 6 月已調高 Mac、iPad 及多數其他產品的售價，但 iPhone、Apple Watch、AirPods、Studio Display 及配件則未受影響。
市場目前普遍傳言，蘋果下一波價格調整將以 iPhone 18 Pro 為主。
蘋果預計將於下月推出 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max，以及首款折疊 iPhone；至於標準版 iPhone 18 與 iPhone 18e，則要等到 2027 年春季才會上市。
預計 iPhone 17 至少到明年仍將是蘋果的主流機型，可能成為蘋果在新一代產品上市前，單獨調整 iPhone 17 售價的充分理由。
若漲價成真，目前仍無法確定蘋果調高 iPhone 17 售價是否會涵蓋整個產品線，包括售價 599 美元的 iPhone 17e、799 美元的 iPhone 17、999 美元的 iPhone Air、1,099 美元的 iPhone 17 Pro，以及 1,199 美元的 iPhone 17 Pro Max，抑或僅有部分機型受到影響。
paras_en: According to the latest rumors, Apple (AAPL-US) may raise the price of iPhone 17 as early as August 10, beating the expected price hike cycle, and a more significant price adjustment is expected to accompany the release of iPhone 18 Pro next month.
A report by MacRumors cites a Weibo account called 'Fixed Focus Digital' stating that the market is circulating rumors that iPhone 17 will adjust its price starting from August 10.

However, the whistleblower did not explicitly confirm whether the price will indeed be raised; instead, the post is more certain that Apple has canceled plans to increase production capacity by 15% to 30%.
It is unclear which components or products are involved in the production adjustment mentioned in the post.

Given the significant increase in memory and storage component costs, Apple raised the prices of Mac, iPad, and most other products in June, but iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods, Studio Display, and accessories were not affected.
The market is currently speculating that Apple's next price hike will focus on iPhone 18 Pro.
Apple plans to release iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the first foldable iPhone next month, while the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e will be released in the spring of 2027.

It is expected that iPhone 17 will remain Apple's mainstream model at least until next year and may be a sufficient reason for Apple to adjust the price of iPhone 17 before the release of new products.

If the price hike is confirmed, it is still unclear whether Apple will raise the prices of all iPhone models, including the iPhone 17e ($599), iPhone 17 ($799), iPhone Air ($999), iPhone 17 Pro ($1,099), and iPhone 17 Pro Max ($1,199), or only some models will be affected.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉藥華藥與AOP部分仲裁判賠近億歐元 無懼利空消息觸及漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Yuyue Pharmaceutical and AOP Partial Arbitration Ruling: NT$36 Billion in Damages, Undaunted by Profit Warning
paras: 藥華藥周六 (8 日) 召開重訊記者會，說明與 AOP 仲裁案第二階段部分仲裁判斷，仲裁庭認定藥華藥需支付 AOP 約 9748 萬歐元 (約新台幣 36 億元)，不過藥華藥營收規模已穩健，2025 年營收達 156 億元、累計今年前 7 月營收近 145 億元，對財務無重大影響，藥華藥今 (10) 日抗空，一度觸及漲停但未鎖住。
藥華藥今天早盤 1200 元開低，不過盤中翻紅走揚，一度觸及漲停價 1360 元，不過未鎖住，截至 11 點 10 分，股價暫報 1340 元，漲幅超過 8%，成交量超過 3000 張。
藥華藥說明，此次仲裁庭認定，藥華藥延遲取得歐洲藥證及延遲供貨爭議，與 AOP 積欠的貨款與權利金約 1700 萬歐元相抵後，藥華藥需支付約 6588 萬 1114.27 歐元 (約新台幣 24.52 億元)，加上藥品採購價格爭議，藥華藥需退還 3160 萬 1477.5 歐元 (約新台幣 11.76 億元)，合計判賠約 9748 萬 2580.77 歐元 (約新台幣 36.28 億元)。
藥華藥強調，近年公司營收規模持續擴大，2025 年營收達 156 億元、累計今年前 7 月營收近 145 億元，對公司營運與財務無重大影響，且針對此案的應對措施，將研擬撤銷仲裁判斷事宜。
藥華藥 7 月營收 25.07 億元，月增 7.47%，年增 92.59%，續創單月歷史新高；累計今年前 7 月營收 144.84 億元，年增 77.46%。
paras_en: Yuyue Pharmaceutical held a press conference on Saturday (8th) to explain the second-stage partial arbitration ruling in the arbitration case with AOP. The arbitration court ruled that Yuyue Pharmaceutical must pay AOP approximately NT$3.6 billion, but Yuyue Pharmaceutical's revenue scale has been stable, with NT$156 billion in revenue in 2025 and NT$145 billion in revenue for the first seven months of this year, with no significant impact on its finances. Yuyue Pharmaceutical rose to NT$1200 today (10th) and briefly touched the limit-up price of NT$1360, but failed to lock it in.

Yuyue Pharmaceutical's stock price opened at NT$1200 today, but turned red and rose during the session, briefly touching the limit-up price of NT$1360, but failing to lock it in. As of 11:10, the stock price was NT$1340, with a gain of over 8% and a trading volume of over 3000 shares.

Yuyue Pharmaceutical explained that the arbitration court ruled that Yuyue Pharmaceutical's delay in obtaining European pharmaceutical certificates and delay in supplying goods was a controversy with AOP's overdue payment and royalty of approximately NT$170 million, which was offset by Yuyue Pharmaceutical's payment of approximately NT$6588 million 1114.27 euros (approximately NT$24.52 billion), plus the controversy over the price of pharmaceuticals, Yuyue Pharmaceutical must refund NT$3160 million 1477.5 euros (approximately NT$11.76 billion), totaling approximately NT$9748 million 2580.77 euros (approximately NT$36.28 billion) in damages.

Yuyue Pharmaceutical emphasized that the company's revenue scale has continued to expand in recent years, with NT$156 billion in revenue in 2025 and NT$145 billion in revenue for the first seven months of this year, with no significant impact on the company's operations and finances. The company will also research and prepare to revoke the arbitration ruling.

Yuyue Pharmaceutical's July revenue was NT$2.507 billion, with a monthly increase of 7.47% and a year-on-year increase of 92.59%, setting a new single-month record. The company's cumulative revenue for the first seven months of this year was NT$144.84 billion, with a year-on-year increase of 77.46%.

items.title: 砸1兆日元！索尼傳攜手台積電日本建廠 攻機器人、車用次世代感測器
items.title_en: Sony and TSMC to Invest ¥1 Trillion in Japan Factory for Robots and Next-Gen Sensors
paras: 彭博引述消息人士報導，索尼 (SONY-US) 與台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 正針對在日本合資建廠一案進行協商，雙方預計將共同斥資達 1 兆日元（約 64 億美元）。
消息人士表示，索尼旗下半導體事業「索尼半導體解決方案公司」將與台積電攜手合作，鎖定車用與機器人領域，共同開發次世代影像感測器。對此，索尼與台積電均未回應置評請求。
這項正在討論中的投資計畫，此前已由《日本經濟新聞》報導。這也是索尼影像感測器業務朝向「輕資產化」策略轉型的最新布局。近年來，索尼逐步將更多資源投入音樂發行權、電影內容以及遊戲 IP 等智慧財產領域。
消息公布後，索尼股價週一 (10 日) 早盤一度上漲 2.2%，台積電股價也上漲 1.7%。
報導稱，該合資計畫將落腳於日本九州熊本縣，亦即台積電日本晶圓廠的所在地。雙方先前曾表示，若能進一步獲得日本政府的政策補貼與支持，未來不排除擴大廠區規模。
索尼雖僅為台積電熊本廠的少數股東，但在此次新成立的合資公司中，索尼將取得主導權成為控股大股東。
總部位於東京的索尼，長期以來穩居蘋果 (AAPL-US) 、華為與三星電子 (005930KS) 等指標大廠的高階影像感測器主力供應商。近期，該公司更積極拓展業務版圖，力拚將感測元件技術延伸至車載應用與機器人等新興市場。
paras_en: Sony Corp (SONY-US) and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (2330-TW)(TSM-US) are in talks to jointly build a factory in Japan, with the two companies expected to invest a combined ¥1 trillion ($7.9 billion), according to people familiar with the matter.

The two companies plan to collaborate on developing next-generation image sensors for the automotive and robotics markets through Sony's semiconductor unit, Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corp, the people said. Sony and TSMC declined to comment on the matter.

The investment plan, which was previously reported by the Nikkei newspaper, is part of Sony's strategy to shift its image sensor business towards a 'light asset' approach. In recent years, Sony has been investing more resources in music publishing rights, film content, and gaming IP.
Sony's shares rose 2.2% in early trading on Monday, while TSMC's shares gained 1.7% after the news was reported.

The joint venture is expected to be located in Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, where TSMC has a chip factory. The two companies have previously said they would consider expanding the factory's scale if they receive policy support from the Japanese government.
Sony, which owns a small stake in TSMC's Kumamoto factory, will become the majority shareholder of the new joint venture, giving it control over the company.

Sony, based in Tokyo, has long been a major supplier of high-end image sensors to companies like Apple Inc (AAPL-US), Huawei Technologies Co and Samsung Electronics Co (005930KS). The company has been actively expanding its business into new areas, including automotive and robotics applications.

items.title: 力士7月營收創四年高 下半年營運穩步回升
items.title_en: Powerchip Sees Record Revenue in July, Expects Stable Growth in Second Half
paras: MOSFET 廠力士 (4923-TW) 7 月營收達 1.2 億元，月增 19.94%，年增 49.73%，公司表示，受惠 IDM 大廠訂單外溢，加上公司擴大供應鏈布局，帶動 7 月營收創下四年來新高，展望下半年，除了低軌衛星 (LEO) 接收器產品將在下半年陸續導入，也推出 AI 邊緣伺服器用的功率元件，可望進一步挹注營運動能。
力士指出，由於國際 IDM 大廠持續將產能轉向 AI 相關高毛利產品，帶動低、中壓 MOSFET 訂單外溢，公司也持續擴大供應鏈認證、提升產品滲透率，即使整體消費性電子市場受到記憶體供應吃緊影響，終端需求成長趨緩，力士仍憑藉多元產品布局與客戶導入效益，繳出單月營收創新高佳績。
力士表示，近期上游原物料成本持續攀升，國際半導體大廠已陸續啟動價格調整，公司亦自第二季起逐步反映成本變化、調整產品售價，以降低原物料上漲對營運造成的影響，並維持整體獲利能力。
獲利表現方面，力士上半年營收達新台幣 5.15 億元，較去年同期成長 26.43%，毛利率提升至 28%，主要係因營收規模擴大及產品組合持續優化，帶動毛利率較去年同期明顯改善，營業利益 124.6 萬元，且在業外費用控制得宜下，稅後淨利 1,669.8 萬元，每股稅後盈餘 (EPS)0.5 元，較去年表現由虧轉盈，顯示營運體質持續改善、獲利能力穩步提升。
產品布局方面，力士持續擴大電源供應器應用領域，除既有筆電 / PC 產品外，遊戲機相關產品已正式開始量產交貨，低軌衛星 (LEO) 接收器產品亦可望於下半年陸續導入，進一步挹注營運動能。
因應 AI 應用快速發展，力士亦持續投入新產品研發，目前已針對小型 AI 邊緣伺服器推出符合市場需求的 MOSFET 產品，包括散熱風扇、熱插拔 (Hot Swap) 等電源管理應用，現階段正透過既有合作系統廠進行送樣與認證，未來可望隨 AI 邊緣運算與小型 AI 伺服器市場規模擴大，逐步貢獻營收。
在電池應用方面，力士已取得多家國內外大廠認證，產品應用涵蓋無人機、伺服器備援電池 (BBU) 等領域，並持續投入新產品設計與客戶導入，積極拓展終端應用版圖，掌握 AI、高效能運算及新能源市場帶來的新商機。
展望 2026，力士表示，隨著預訂代工產能將自下半年起陸續到位，可望有效滿足客戶持續增加的訂單需求，搭配 AI 帶動 MOSFET 市場需求升溫、訂單外溢與新應用產品陸續放量，以及產品組合持續朝高附加價值方向優化，公司對下半年營運維持審慎樂觀看法，預期營收與獲利表現將逐季增溫，並持續提升產品競爭力與市場滲透率，為全年營運成長挹注穩健動能。
paras_en: Powerchip (4923-TW) reported a record revenue of NT$1.2 billion in July, up 19.94% from the previous month and 49.73% from the same period last year. The company attributed the growth to increased orders from IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) companies and its expanded supply chain layout.

Powerchip noted that IDM companies have been shifting their production capacity to AI-related high-margin products, leading to an increase in low- and medium-pressure MOSFET orders. The company has been expanding its supply chain certification and improving product penetration, despite the overall consumer electronics market being affected by memory supply constraints.

Powerchip stated that recent upstream raw material costs have continued to rise, and international semiconductor companies have begun to implement price adjustments. The company has reflected these cost changes and adjusted product prices since the second quarter to mitigate the impact on operations and maintain overall profitability.

In terms of profitability, Powerchip's first-half revenue reached NT$5.15 billion, a 26.43% increase from the same period last year. Gross margin improved to 28%, mainly due to increased revenue scale and optimized product mix. Operating income was NT$1.246 million, and net income after tax was NT$16.698 million, with EPS of NT$0.5, a significant improvement from last year's loss.

In terms of product layout, Powerchip has expanded its power supply application domain, including notebook/PC products, gaming-related products, and low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite receiver products, which are expected to be introduced in the second half.

To address the rapid development of AI applications, Powerchip has continued to invest in new product development, including MOSFET products for small AI edge servers, such as heat sinks, hot-swappable power management applications, and other products. These products are currently being sampled and certified through existing cooperation systems and are expected to contribute to revenue growth as the AI edge computing and small AI server markets expand.

In the battery application area, Powerchip has obtained certifications from multiple domestic and foreign major companies, covering applications such as drones, server backup batteries (BBU), and other areas. The company continues to invest in new product design and customer introduction, actively expanding its terminal application territory and seizing new business opportunities in AI, high-performance computing, and new energy markets.

Looking ahead to 2026, Powerchip expects to see a significant increase in demand for its products, driven by the introduction of new applications, such as AI-powered MOSFET products, and the expansion of its product portfolio to high-value-added products. The company maintains a cautious optimism for the second half, expecting revenue and profitability to increase quarter by quarter and continue to improve its product competitiveness and market penetration.

items.title_en: Focus Stock: US Missile Inventory in Crisis, 00965 Surges Over 2% to New High
paras: 全球國防財報公布進入收官階段，美國 AI 國防軟體與國安科技獲利爆發，加上盤面浮上美國飛彈庫存吃緊利多，帶動元大航太防衛科技 (00965-TW) 今 (10) 日開盤跳漲逾 2%，股價重返新高。
在美伊衝突曠日廢時下，美國全球防衛面臨防空飛彈庫存快速減少處境，據華府智庫估計，愛國者飛彈庫存較開戰前減少 65%；華盛頓郵報報導，美國國防部副部長日前已致函國防產業，要求加快交付時程與提升產能。
而根據美國戰略暨國際研究中心資料，因高消耗而進入生產高峰的不僅愛國者，還包括薩德飛彈與精準打擊飛彈。主要生產商洛克希德馬丁 (Lockheed Martin) 近一月股價上漲 13.5%。
涵蓋歐美亞太國防供應鏈的元大航太防衛科技 (00965-TW)，10 日股價順勢飆漲，盤中刷下 27.2 元新高，近一周股價勁揚 7.4%。7 月全球股市震盪以來，00965 保持上漲 7.4%，優於大型科技指數包括費城半導體指數下跌 13.3%。
法人指出，目前全球股市的 AI 及國防兩大題材，兩者背後均包含對主導未來世界格局的地位追求，資金投入所帶動的結構性成長不容小覷。國防部分，美國 AI 國防軟體龍頭 Palantir 第二季美國政府業務年增 90%，商用業務受 AI 平台驅動年增 149%，近一月股價重新發動，大漲 33.3%。
法人表示，全球國防產業具備明確的政策與訂單支撐，難出現供過於求的失衡情形，相對科技股較無景氣循環益率。隨著各國持續推進新年度國防預算立法程序，在政策面、財務面等消息釋出之際，將有助強化全球軍工國防股延續上漲動能，建議投資人可趁勢布局。

paras_en: The global defense industry report has entered the final stage, with AI defense software and national security technology in the US experiencing a surge in profits, combined with the bullish sentiment of tight US missile inventory, driving Meta Aviation Defense Technology (00965-TW) to surge over 2% today, returning to a new high.

In the absence of a US-Iran conflict, the US global defense is facing a situation of rapid depletion of air defense missile inventory, with estimates from Washington think tanks indicating that the Patriot missile inventory has decreased by 65% since the start of the conflict; The Washington Post reported that the US Deputy Secretary of Defense has recently written to the defense industry, requesting accelerated delivery schedules and increased production capacity.

According to data from the US Strategic and International Studies Center, not only the Patriot missile, but also the Sade missile and the Precision Strike Missile have entered a production peak due to high consumption. The main manufacturer, Lockheed Martin, has seen its stock price rise by 13.5% in the past month.

Meta Aviation Defense Technology (00965-TW), which covers the defense supply chain of Europe, America, and the Asia-Pacific, surged in price on the 10th, brushing a new high of 27.2 yuan, with a strong rise of 7.4% in the past week. Since the global stock market volatility in July, 00965 has maintained an increase of 7.4%, outperforming major technology indices, including the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, which fell 13.3%.

Experts point out that the current global stock market's two major themes, AI and defense, both contain the pursuit of a leading position in shaping the future world order, and the structural growth driven by capital investment cannot be underestimated. In the defense sector, the US AI defense software leader Palantir saw its US government business increase by 90% in the second quarter, and its commercial business driven by the AI platform increased by 149% in the year, with its stock price rebounding strongly, rising by 33.3% in the past month.

Experts note that the global defense industry has clear policies and order support, making it difficult to appear in a situation of oversupply, unlike technology stocks, which have a lower cyclical yield rate. As various countries continue to push forward the legislative process for next year's defense budget, the release of policy and financial information will help strengthen the continuation of the upward momentum of global military-industrial defense stocks, suggesting that investors can take advantage of the situation to layout.

items.title: 〈房產〉卡位台積電、輝達概念國小 以桃園新設校數量居冠也有低門檻卡位區
items.title_en: Taipei and Taoyuan Top the List for New Elementary Schools with Affordable Housing Options
paras: 少子化浪潮下，六都還是陸續規劃了 9 所新小學。房仲業者統計六都今年起新設立的 9 所國小周邊住宅實價行情，其中以台北市的洲美國小周邊房價最高，預售屋均價每坪 123.8 萬元，中古屋每坪均價 75.7 萬元，都是 9 所新校中之冠。
而桃園市的龍科國小，預售屋均價 31 萬元，中古屋均價 21.5 萬元，則是新設國小當中，卡位單價門檻最親民的學校。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心執行長張旭嵐表示，少子化趨勢下，許多學校都在減班、併校，而六都新設立國小，大致可歸納為三種型態。首先是「園區展望型」，因學校位於產業園區方圓 1 公里內，近年受 AI 帶動，園區附近的就業、居住與就學需求提高，催生新校設立。
其中北士科內的洲美國小，在輝達海外總部拍板北士科後，被戲稱為「輝達國小」，桃園市龍潭區的龍科國小、高雄楠梓的藍田國小也因鄰近台積電 (2330-TW) 廠區，成為「台積概念國小」；林口的力行國小附近亦有新北國際 AI + 園區加持；大園區的航科國小則坐落客運園區，與大園產業園區、觀音產業園區也相距不遠，凸顯產業發展與人口剛需的緊密連結。
另一種為「軌道加持型」，區段受軌道發展帶動，吸引人口移居周邊新興重劃區，比如台中北屯的南興國小鄰近台鐵與中捷綠線共站的松竹站，加上所在的單元十二重劃區新案完工後，人口增速快，使地方政府積極籌建公共建設；烏日的旭光國小更位處台中唯一三鐵共構的烏日高鐵特區，區段後續還不乏大型住商開發案推動發展，房市前景備受關注。
另外有「重劃成熟型」，包括平鎮南勢重劃區的平鎮國小，以及中壢過嶺重劃區的過嶺國小，因重劃區開發至今超過 10 年，已脫離草創階段，邁入穩定長人時期，使區段的剛性需求相對厚實，周邊住宅市場及學區價值也同步提升。
張旭嵐指出，新設立的國小，常結合雙語教學、實驗教學等精緻化教育且招生初期學生人數少，也更容易獲得教學資源，使新學校的學區宅在市場上頗受歡迎。不過在學校周邊購屋，並非進入目標學校就讀的保證，各縣市教育局會依招生人數及學區人口變化，於正式招生前公告最新學區範圍，部分熱門學校甚至需提早多年設籍，因此家長購屋前，除評估房價與生活機能外，也應先確認最新學區劃分及設籍規定，避免因學區調整影響就學權益。
全台六都新設立的 9 所學校，桃園市獨佔 4 所，是未來 10 年內新設國小最多的都會，反映桃園市近年強勁的人口成長動能，僅僅今年上半年，桃園市就淨遷入將近 4000 人，人口成長數高居全台第一。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心資深經理陳定中表示，桃園受惠航空城計畫、捷運路網延伸及首都圈內相對親民的房價，持續吸引年輕家庭移居，也使過嶺重劃區、大園客運園區等新興發展區的住宅需求增加，必須同步擴充教育資源，因此成為六都中新設國小最密集的城市。
陳定中指出，由於各國小周邊的房價結構不同，往往使想爭取設籍時間又想兼顧購屋預算的家長傷透腦筋。台北市洲美國小周邊的新舊屋價差大，中古屋價格遠比新案平實，也有助於立即設籍，是卡位學區相對有利的選擇。而桃園的過嶺國小、航科國小及龍科國小，位處新開發區段，新舊屋屋齡差距不大，預售屋與中古屋每坪價差僅約 6- 10 萬元，在預算允許下，可優先選擇新屋，以兼顧居住品質與未來保值性。
paras_en: In the face of the declining birth rate, the six municipalities have continued to plan for 9 new elementary schools. Real estate agents have compiled data on the new elementary schools in the six municipalities, with Taipei's Zhongshan Elementary School having the highest housing prices. The average price of pre-sale houses is NT$1,238,000 per ping, and the average price of old houses is NT$75,700 per ping, making it the top school among the 9 new schools.

Taoyuan's Longguo Elementary School has the lowest threshold for new house prices, with an average price of NT$310,000 per ping, and an average price of NT$21,500 per ping for old houses, making it the most affordable school among the new schools.

Taiwan Real Estate Group Trend Center Executive Director Zhang Xuruilan pointed out that in the face of the declining birth rate, many schools have reduced classes and merged schools. The new elementary schools in the six municipalities can be roughly categorized into three types. The first type is the 'park zone prospect type', where the school is located within a 1-kilometer radius of an industrial park. In recent years, the park has been driven by AI, and the demand for employment, residence, and education has increased, giving birth to the establishment of new schools.

Among them, North Zhongshan Elementary School in Beitou, Taipei, was nicknamed 'Huadai Elementary School' after Huadai Overseas Headquarters decided to set up a branch in Beitou. Taoyuan's Longtan District's Longguo Elementary School, Kaohsiung's Lantian Elementary School, and Lin Kou's Lixing Elementary School are all located near the TSMC (2330-TW) factory zone, making them 'TSMC concept elementary schools'.

The second type is the 'railway support type', where the area is driven by railway development, attracting population to move to new emerging redevelopment areas. For example, Taichung's Nanxing Elementary School is located near the Taichung Railway Station and the Taichung Metro Green Line, and after the completion of the single unit 12 redevelopment area, the population grew rapidly, prompting the local government to actively plan for public construction.

The third type is the 'redevelopment mature type', including Pingzhen's Pingzhen Elementary School and Zhongli's Guoli Elementary School, which have been developed for over 10 years and have entered a stable long-term period, making the area's rigid demand relatively strong, and the surrounding residential market and school district values have also risen synchronously.

Zhang Xuruilan pointed out that new elementary schools often combine bilingual education, experimental education, and other refined education, and the initial number of students is small, making it easier to obtain teaching resources, making the new school's school district a popular choice in the market. However, purchasing a house near the school does not guarantee admission to the school, and the local education department will announce the latest school district boundaries and enrollment requirements before formal enrollment.

Among the 9 new schools in the six municipalities, Taoyuan has 4 schools, making it the city with the most new elementary schools in the next 10 years. This reflects Taoyuan's strong population growth momentum in recent years, with nearly 4,000 people moving in during the first half of the year, making it the city with the highest population growth rate in Taiwan.

Taiwan Real Estate Group Trend Center Senior Manager Chen Dingzhong pointed out that Taoyuan has benefited from the Aviation City Plan, the extension of the subway network, and the relatively affordable housing prices in the capital circle, attracting young families to move in, and increasing the demand for residential housing in emerging development areas such as the Overpass Redevelopment Area and the Daan Bus Station Area.

Chen Dingzhong pointed out that due to the different housing price structures around each elementary school, parents who want to secure a seat in the school but also want to consider their budget are often at a loss. Taipei's Zhongshan Elementary School has a large price difference between new and old houses, with old house prices far more affordable than new houses, making it a relatively advantageous choice for securing a seat in the school. In Taoyuan, the Overpass Elementary School, the Aviation Elementary School, and the Longguo Elementary School are located in newly developed areas, with a relatively small price difference between new and old houses, making it possible to choose new houses within budget to balance living quality and future appreciation.
