items.title: 美股壞消息不斷卻「越漲越勇」！資金湧入半導體、高收益債與比特幣
paras: 半導體股重挫、公債殖利率居高不下、地緣政治風險未解，華爾街近來壞消息不斷，但資金流向說的卻是完全不同的故事。美股創新高之際，資金同步湧入高收益債與比特幣 ETF，推升美銀牛熊指標至 2021 年以來高點，市場情緒明顯升溫。
上週，標普 500 指數改寫歷史新高，那斯達克 100 指數繳出近兩個月最亮眼的單週表現；同一時間，高收益債券基金單週吸金達 40 億美元、創下近兩年新高，比特幣相關 ETF 五個交易日內也淨流入 5 億美元。
美銀「牛熊指標」隨之攀升至 2021 年以來的最高點，顯示市場情緒已明顯轉向樂觀。
這波樂觀情緒，正好發生在一場戲劇性事件之後。由有「矽谷股神」之稱的 Leopold Aschenbrenner 所創立的 AI 主題避險基金 Situational Awareness 爆倉，一度將費城半導體指數自六月高點拖低 29%。
然而市場並未如過往般選擇避險撤退，反倒把這場動盪當成進場訊號。短短兩個交易日內，每日 3 倍看多半導體 ETF(SOXL-US) 便湧入逾 20 億美元資金，隨後七個交易日累計漲幅超過 50%。
兩檔規模最大的非槓桿半導體 ETF 同期也合計吸金逾 70 億美元，各自上漲約 16%。整體而言，半導體相關槓桿與非槓桿基金上週合計吸引超過 110 億美元資金。
JonesTrading 首席市場策略師 Michael O"Rourke 將這股買氣形容為動能買盤掀起的「海嘯」，但他也提醒，不少資金依然集中在市值最大的幾檔科技股上，真正撐起指數漲勢的主力仍是七巨頭。

從股市到債市、加密貨幣，風險偏好全面回溫

分析人士指出，推升行情的不只是晶片股，而是跨資產類別的全面資金涌入。
根據美銀統計，高收益債券基金上週淨流入 40 億美元，創下兩年來單週新高；比特幣 ETF 儘管幣價已橫盤數月，五個交易日內仍吸金 5 億美元。
美銀牛熊指標因此升至 2021 年來高點，策略師 Michael Hartnett 團隊的分析指出，漲勢已從科技股核心板塊擴散開來，加上高收益債資金強勁、信用利差收窄，共同撐起了這股樂觀氛圍。
Natixis Investment Managers Solutions 投資組合策略師 Garrett Melson 則認為，眼下市場的疑慮被過度放大，風險資產基本面其實穩固。
他目前維持美股超配、聚焦大型科技股的部位，固定收益則相對低配。
Melson 強調，整體經濟表現依然良好，情緒與部位有時會過度延伸，但這種過熱只是局部現象, 類股輪動反而有助於消化泡沫、同時支撐大盤。

殖利率仍居高不下，成為最大隱憂

不過這場多頭盛宴並非毫無陰影。30 年期美債殖利率雖然近五個交易日有四天回落，但仍徘徊在近二十年高點附近，成為市場揮之不去的壓力來源。
至於殖利率為何居高不下，市場看法分歧。
一派認為 7 月底的飆升，是因為聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）未能給出明確的利率指引，讓外界對其抗通膨決心產生疑慮；另一派則認為，這其實反映投資人對經濟持續擴張的信心。
上週五公布的美國 7 月就業數據意外轉弱，加上前兩月數據下修，反而提振了股市、壓低了殖利率，市場因此押注聯準會短期內不至於被迫升息。
高盛資產管理的 Lindsay Rosner 指出，隨著數據逐漸明朗、油價趨穩，經濟全貌以及資本支出的回報率也變得更清晰，整體經濟依然強勁，市場正在消化 AI 相關的供給變化。
Wealth Enhancement 資深投資策略師 Ayako Yoshioka 則提醒，半導體雖仍是 AI 基礎建設的核心，但接下來的瓶頸恐怕會轉移到電力供應不足，而殖利率走高本身，仍是必須留意的風險。

每次回調都被視為買點，多頭信心愈戰愈強

分析指出，支撐這波風險偏好的，還有一種在市場上一再被驗證的心理慣性，即每次拉回都很短暫，每次恐慌都是進場機會。
Manulife Investment Management 資深投資組合經理 Nathan Thooft 觀察到，價格修正一再證明只是曇花一現，這種經驗不斷強化投資人的信心；反倒是在不確定性最高時選擇出場的人，往往錯過隨後最強勁的反彈。
Thooft 直言，現金雖然感覺安全，長期卻難以跑贏通膨與股市的獲利成長。他認為過去十年，那些一直等待更理想進場時機的投資人，大多已被市場拋在後頭。
市場情緒的快速修復，也反映在波動率指標上。芝加哥選擇權交易所（Cboe）半導體 ETF 波動率指數本週下滑近 9 個點，創下今年最大單週跌幅。儘管風險清單仍在拉長，但資金的實際流向，顯然仍指向風險資產。

items.title: iPhone 17要漲價了？傳蘋果最快8/10調高售價、記憶體成本飆升成關鍵
items.title_en: iPhone 17 May See Price Hike: Apple to Raise Prices as Early as August 10, Memory Costs Soar
paras: 根據最新傳聞，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 最快可能在本週一（10 日）調高 iPhone 17 售價，時間點甚至早於外界預期的下一波漲價，而更大規模的價格調整則預計將伴隨下月 iPhone 18 Pro 上市登場。
根據《MacRumors》報導，微博爆料帳號「Fixed Focus Digital」昨日發文表示，市場目前流傳 iPhone 17 將於 10 日起調整價格的消息。
不過，該爆料者並未明確表示價格是否真的會上調；相較之下，貼文較為確定地指出，蘋果已取消部分生產線將產能由原本增加 15% 至 30% 的計畫。
目前尚不清楚該貼文所指的產能調整，具體涉及哪些零組件或產品。
基於記憶體與儲存元件成本大幅上升，蘋果今年 6 月已調高 Mac、iPad 及多數其他產品的售價，但 iPhone、Apple Watch、AirPods、Studio Display 及配件則未受影響。
市場目前普遍傳言，蘋果下一波價格調整將以 iPhone 18 Pro 為主。
蘋果預計將於下月推出 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max，以及首款折疊 iPhone；至於標準版 iPhone 18 與 iPhone 18e，則要等到 2027 年春季才會上市。
預計 iPhone 17 至少到明年仍將是蘋果的主流機型，可能成為蘋果在新一代產品上市前，單獨調整 iPhone 17 售價的充分理由。
若漲價成真，目前仍無法確定蘋果調高 iPhone 17 售價是否會涵蓋整個產品線，包括售價 599 美元的 iPhone 17e、799 美元的 iPhone 17、999 美元的 iPhone Air、1,099 美元的 iPhone 17 Pro，以及 1,199 美元的 iPhone 17 Pro Max，抑或僅有部分機型受到影響。
paras_en: According to the latest rumors, Apple (AAPL-US) may raise the price of iPhone 17 as early as August 10, beating the expected price hike cycle, and a more significant price adjustment is expected to accompany the release of iPhone 18 Pro next month.
A report by MacRumors cites a Weibo account called 'Fixed Focus Digital' stating that the market is circulating rumors that iPhone 17 will adjust its price starting from August 10.

However, the whistleblower did not explicitly confirm whether the price will indeed be raised; instead, the post is more certain that Apple has canceled plans to increase production capacity by 15% to 30%.
It is unclear which components or products are involved in the production adjustment mentioned in the post.

Given the significant increase in memory and storage component costs, Apple raised the prices of Mac, iPad, and most other products in June, but iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods, Studio Display, and accessories were not affected.
The market is currently speculating that Apple's next price hike will focus on iPhone 18 Pro.
Apple plans to release iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the first foldable iPhone next month, while the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e will be released in the spring of 2027.

It is expected that iPhone 17 will remain Apple's mainstream model at least until next year and may be a sufficient reason for Apple to adjust the price of iPhone 17 before the release of new products.

If the price hike is confirmed, it is still unclear whether Apple will raise the prices of all iPhone models, including the iPhone 17e ($599), iPhone 17 ($799), iPhone Air ($999), iPhone 17 Pro ($1,099), and iPhone 17 Pro Max ($1,199), or only some models will be affected.

items.title: 首款都還未發！蘋果折疊iPhone三代路線圖先曝光 傳內外雙螢幕最快2028年放大
items.title_en: Apple's First Foldable iPhone Not Yet Released, But Third-Generation Roadmap Leaked
paras: 蘋果首款折疊 iPhone 尚未亮相，但三代產品路線圖已先行曝光，知名科技記者古爾曼近日在《Power On》通訊中披露，蘋果已著手規劃第三代折疊 iPhone，最快 2028 年推出，新機內外雙螢幕尺寸都將比前兩代進一步放大。
按目前節奏，初代折疊 iPhone 預計下月登場，第二代定檔 2027 年，第三代最快 2028 年跟進，這是業界首次出現「第三代」具體時程爆料。
古爾曼指出，初代折疊 iPhone 外螢幕約 5.5 吋、內螢幕約 7.8 吋，第三代若繼續放大，整機可視面積將再上一階，但具體數字古爾曼未透露。
初代硬體輪廓同步浮現：超薄機身、捨棄 Face ID 改回 Touch ID、搭載 A20 晶片與自研 C2 基帶，命名可能叫「iPhone Ultra」，要價 2000 美元起跳。
蘋果第二代「Ultra 2」項目已獲准開發，螢幕方案很大機率沿用初代，預計 2027 年秋季與 iPhone 問世 20 週年紀念機同台，第三代折疊 iPhone 則是真正把「大螢幕體驗」再推一層的版本。
業內人士解讀，蘋果顯然不把折疊 iPhone 當單發試水產品。初代折疊 iPhone 重點是把書本式折疊形態、幾乎無摺痕與高耐久鉸鏈落地；二代延續方案、陪跑 20 週年紀念機；三代靠螢幕放大拉開代差。
供應鏈指出，蘋果近期已上調 2026、2027 年折疊機出貨預期，初代量產 7 月下旬啟動，市場正盯著 9 月發表會驗證「Ultra」定價與形態能否重洗高階手機格局。
paras_en: Apple's first foldable iPhone has yet to be released, but the roadmap for its third generation has been leaked. Renowned tech journalist Gurman recently revealed in his Power On newsletter that Apple has already begun planning its third-generation foldable iPhone, which is expected to be released as early as 2028. The new device will feature larger inner and outer screens compared to its predecessors.

Based on the current pace, the first-generation foldable iPhone is expected to debut next month, followed by the second generation in 2027, and the third generation as early as 2028. This is the first time a specific timeline for the third generation has been leaked.

Gurman noted that the first-generation foldable iPhone has an outer screen of approximately 5.5 inches and an inner screen of around 7.8 inches. If the third generation continues to increase in size, the overall visible area of the device will increase further, although Gurman did not disclose specific numbers.

The hardware design of the first generation has also been revealed: a super-thin body, the abandonment of Face ID in favor of Touch ID, the use of the A20 chip and a custom C2 baseband, and a possible name of "iPhone Ultra" with a starting price of $2,000.

Apple's second-generation "Ultra 2" project has been approved for development, and it is likely that the screen scheme will be similar to the first generation. The device is expected to be released in the fall of 2027, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of the iPhone.

Industry insiders interpret this as Apple not treating the foldable iPhone as a single test product. The first-generation foldable iPhone focused on implementing a book-like folding design, almost no creases, and high durability hinges. The second generation continued the scheme, while the third generation will rely on larger screens to create a wider price gap.

The supply chain has indicated that Apple has recently increased its expectations for foldable iPhone shipments in 2026 and 2027. The first-generation production is expected to start in late July, and the market is watching the September launch event to see if the "Ultra" pricing and design can shake up the high-end smartphone market.

items.title: 貝森特連出「3招」救長債！美債殖利率飆破5%  市場憂通膨、赤字成未爆彈
paras: 美債殖利率飆升正逼迫美國財政部出手應對。30 年期公債殖利率一度衝上 5.27%、創 19 年新高之際，美財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）近一週連出三招，從聯手日本干預日元、暗示可能縮減長債發行，到力挺聯準會主席華許，試圖壓抑長天期利率升勢。然而，在高通膨、巨額財政赤字與地緣政治風險等結構性壓力下，市場仍質疑這些政策工具究竟能否真正扭轉美債殖利率走高的趨勢。
摩根大通資產管理公司投資組合經理人 Priya Misra 指出，聯準會與財政部顯然都對長天期利率的走勢感到不安，而貝森特近期的種種操作，正是要向市場傳達財政部已經掌握利率動向、且不惜動用一切政策工具因應的訊號。
8 月 3 日，美日兩國財政部同步證實已聯手進場買進日元，是美國睽違 28 年再度出手干預日元匯率。
當天一張被媒體捕捉到的貝森特內閣會議筆記，意外洩漏了行動的來龍去脈。上頭寫著擬買進 50 億至 100 億美元日元的計畫。
然而外界分析，此舉的用意遠不止於「挺盟友」這麼單純。
日本是美國公債最大的海外持有國，持有部位超過 1.1 兆美元。一旦日本為籌措干預資金而被迫拋售美債，勢必進一步推升本已居高不下的美國長天期利率。
分析指出，這在 10 年期公債殖利率創下今年以來新高、30 年期更觸及近 20 年高點的當下，已從單純的理論疑慮，升級為政策必須正面回應的急迫課題。
值得留意的是干預手法本身。貝森特並未直接拋售美元換購日元，因為那將對美債殖利率造成立即衝擊，而是選擇透過賣出歐元、買進日元的迂迴方式完成操作，藉此避開對公債市場的直接影響。
研究機構 RSM 首席經濟學家 Joe Brusuelas 認為，具備避險基金背景的貝森特，看準了這個能同時壓低殖利率曲線、撐住美元並援助重要盟友的時機。
貝森特緊接著又拋出另一張牌：呼籲聯準會擴大「外國與國際貨幣當局附買回機制」的規模。這項機制讓外國央行得以其持有的美債作為擔保品借入美元，無需直接在市場上出售公債部位。
貝森特強調，相較於該機制在 2020 年設立時，如今公債市場規模已大幅膨脹，聯準會考慮擴大這項工具的規模有其合理性。
道富銀行資深總體策略師則認為，這項訊號的重要性甚至可能超越干預本身，因為它明確告訴市場：日本不必賣出美債也能取得美元流動性，等於是把日本手中的「籌碼」，從「拋售美債」切換成「抵押美債」，藉此斬斷日元走貶、美債遭拋售、殖利率被推升的連鎖反應。
紐約梅隆銀行總體策略師 John Velis 則提醒，鑑於目前的財政支出政策與地緣政治情勢，長期而言要緩解利率壓力恐怕相當困難。

鬆口減少長債標售 打破「只增不減」慣例

分析指出，如果說干預日元是貝森特打出的第一張牌，那麼財政部在季度再融資聲明中的措辭調整，影響可能更為深遠。
財政部在 8 月 6 日發布的聲明中，將關於未來附息公債標售規模的表述，由原本的「未來可能增加」，微調為「未來可能出現變化」。這是貝森特自 2025 年初上任以來，財政部首度在長天期公債發行政策上釋出鬆動跡象。
市場迅速將此解讀為財政部未來可能調降 20 年期與 30 年期公債標售規模的訊號。根據 BMO 資本市場調查，約 61% 受訪客戶預期 30 年期公債標售規模下一步的變化方向將是縮減而非擴大。
道明證券美國利率策略主管 Gennadiy Goldberg 認為，這樣的措辭轉變有助於緩和殖利率曲線長端的市場氣氛。
這項訊號打破了市場多年來對美債發行「只增不減」的既定認知。美國公債市場規模自 2018 年以來已翻倍成長至約 31 兆美元，在此背景下，供給端任何邊際上的調整都可能對長天期利率產生不小影響。
不過，德意志銀行策略師 Steven Zeng 也提醒，考慮到政府龐大的融資需求，削減長債發行恐怕並非財政部的基本劇本，這次措辭調整更可能只是為了暫時緩解市場對標售規模持續擴大的疑慮。

力挺華許 卻也埋下矛盾伏筆

貝森特布局的第三步，是公開為聯準會主席華許辯護。
7 月聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議後，華許拒絕就央行何時、如何壓低通膨給出明確指引，一度引發公債市場大舉拋售，市場也質疑其抑制通膨的信譽。
貝森特隨後在媒體上力挺華許，將這種溝通風格形容為一種讓金融市場與財經媒體擺脫對聯準會前瞻指引依賴的「戒斷」過程。
然而，這套方法本身存在明顯的內在矛盾。貝森特一方面試圖透過干預匯市、暗示減少長債供給等手段壓低長天期利率；另一方面，他所力挺的華許式「低調溝通」，恰恰可能是推升長天期利率的因素之一，因為市場因政策不確定性升高，往往會要求更高的期限溢酬作為補償。
瑞銀美國利率策略主管 Phoebe White 指出，財政部近期的一系列動作或許成效有限，但已充分顯示財政部有意動用一切可用工具，阻止長天期殖利率進一步走高。

結構性壓力遠超財政部工具箱

儘管貝森特的三重布局引發市場高度關注，實際效果仍受到嚴峻的結構性因素制約。
短期而言，在匯市干預與油價回落的雙重作用下，10 年期公債殖利率一度回落至 4.61%，但多數分析師認為政策效果有限，目前 30 年期殖利率仍維持在 5% 以上，10 年期也在 4.62% 左右徘徊。
首先是通膨的頑固性。美國通膨率已連續約五年高於聯準會設定的 2% 目標，公債投資人需要看到通膨真正受控的具體證據，才願意接受更低的殖利率。
法國巴黎銀行策略師指出，縮減長債標售雖是壓低殖利率為數不多的有效手段之一，但若財政部逐步、預告式地釋出訊號，恐將削弱政策突襲所能帶來的震撼效果。
其次是財政赤字規模龐大。美國政府每年新增近 2 兆美元赤字，勢必需要持續發行大量新債。德意志銀行認為，考慮到政府龐大的融資需求，削減長債發行並非基本情境；加拿大商業銀行策略師則更直言，縮減部分附息公債標售規模，目前根本尚未被納入政策選項之列。
第三則是地緣政治風險的衝擊。伊朗戰事推升的油價漲勢已引發新一波通膨疑慮，帶動 10 年期公債殖利率升至約 4.65%，高於川普第二任期開始時的水準。
加拿大帝國商業銀行策略師也警告，倘若為減少長天期公債供給而大幅增加短天期公債發行，恐怕也會因需要吸引更多買家而推升短端殖利率。
Onepoint Bfg 首席投資長 Peter Boockvar 示警：「隨著長天期利率走高，美國公債市場明顯已變得相當脆弱，我們也因此呼籲海外持有者不要拋售。」

items.title: AI記憶體超級週期拐點將至？三星、SK海力士DRAM漲幅不及高盛估算 美光下月財報恐補刀
items.title_en: Memory Super Cycle Turning Point Looms? Samsung, SK Hynix DRAM Growth Falls Short of Goldman Estimates, Micron's Q2 Earnings May Be a Knife in the Back
paras: AI 伺服器買盤瘋搶下，DRAM 與 NAND 快閃記憶體價格過去一年大幅飆漲，由三星、SK 海力士、美光壟斷的記憶體市場陷入嚴重缺貨，但隨著兩大韓廠最新季報揭露「漲價幅度不及預期」，市場開始擔心本輪超級週期是否已近獲利高點。
數據顯示，SK 海力士今年第二季 DRAM 均價上季仍漲約 30%、NAND 漲 50%；三星 DRAM 漲幅超 40%、NAND 漲 60%，絕對數字驚人，卻雙雙落後華爾街預期。
高盛原估 SK 海力士 DRAM 漲幅應達 39%，現將本季漲幅預測下修至 19%，晨星亦指三星 DRAM 漲幅低於其 48% 的估算，直言「失望」。
疲軟信號讓投資人警鈴大作。記憶體是典型週期股：新廠從動工到量產需數年，需求暴衝時價格飆升，一旦供給釋出或雲端資本開支降溫，價格回跌會放大利潤收縮。由於市場篤定獲利週期接近頂點，三星、SK 海力士、美光三巨頭股價仍被壓在個位數本益比。
更關鍵的是，合約價與現貨價出現裂口。HBM 與企業級 SSD 多走長約 (LTA)，部分產能提前鎖價，使混合 ASP 漲勢被稀釋，當季營收雖創新高，卻「不如最樂觀預期」，股價反應照例向下。
連鎖效應將燒向美光。分析師推測，美光下月公佈最新一季財報時，該公司 DRAM 定價同樣可能低於共識。短期來看，本季漲幅放緩已成基調，長期則看 2027 年供給若跟進、AI 資本開支邊際降速，本輪由 AI 堆出來的記憶體榮景，恐從「斜率放平」走向「獲利下修」。投資人押注的不該只是漲價延續，而是誰能在 LTA 護城河與自由現金流回饋上扛住向下趨勢。
paras_en: The AI server market has gone wild, driving up the prices of DRAM and NAND flash memory over the past year. The memory market, dominated by Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, has become severely supply-constrained. However, with the latest quarterly reports from the two Korean companies revealing "growth rates below expectations," the market is starting to worry that the current super cycle may have reached its peak profit point.

Data shows that SK Hynix's DRAM average price rose by around 30% in the second quarter compared to the previous quarter, while NAND prices rose by 50%. Samsung's DRAM prices rose by over 40%, while NAND prices rose by 60%. These absolute numbers are impressive, but both companies fell short of Wall Street's expectations.

Goldman Sachs initially estimated that SK Hynix's DRAM prices would rise by 39%, but has now lowered its forecast to 19%. Morningstar also said that Samsung's DRAM price growth was lower than its 48% estimate, saying "disappointing".

The soft signals have triggered a warning bell for investors. Memory is a typical cyclical stock: it takes several years for a new factory to come online, and prices skyrocket when demand surges. Once supply is released or cloud capital expenditure cools down, prices will plummet, and profits will contract. Since the market has determined that the profit cycle is approaching its peak, the stock prices of Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron are still being held back by single-digit P/E ratios.

More importantly, the contract price and spot price have developed a gap. HBM and enterprise SSD have a long-term agreement (LTA), and some production capacity has been pre-priced, diluting the ASP growth. Although the season's revenue has set a new high, it "does not meet the most optimistic expectations," and the stock price has reacted downward as usual.

The chain effect will burn towards Micron. Analysts predict that Micron's latest quarterly earnings report next month will also show that the company's DRAM pricing will be lower than consensus. In the short term, the season's growth slowdown has become a trend, and in the long term, if supply follows in 2027 and AI capital expenditure margins slow down, the memory boom driven by AI will go from "slope flattening" to "profit reduction." Investors should not bet on continued price increases, but rather who can withstand the downward trend in LTA and free cash flow returns.

items.title: AI開始「造AI」了？谷歌發債250億美元、Jeff Dean近期出走創業  專家：全為了All in RSI
items.title_en: Google Raises $25 Billion in Debt, Jeff Dean Leaves to Start New Company
paras: 在市場對 AI 資本支出回報率的質疑聲中，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 正以一場創紀錄的債券發行為下一輪技術豪賭「囤積糧草」。
Alphabet 日前打算發債 250 億美元，卻獲得逾 1150 億美元的超額認購，認購倍數達 4.6 倍，成為今年全球投資級債券市場認購規模第三大交易。這筆鉅額資金背後指向一個日益清晰的戰略方向，也就是 AI 的自進化 --「遞歸式自我改進」(RSI)。
谷歌 DeepMind 首席戰略官 Jasjeet Sekhon 坦言，目前 AI 創造的收入尚無法涵蓋龐大的資本支出，但在技術拐點面前不押注的風險則更高。
他指出，RSI 正是谷歌大額資本支出的核心邏輯。RSI 允許 AI 在極少人類干預下，自主審查並優化自身演算法、架構與訓練流程，進而孵化出更強大的下一代模型。
Sekhon 還將此比作「用蒸汽機製造更先進的蒸汽機」，儘管技術尚不成熟，但模型輔助設計已現端倪。
這一戰略佈局在谷歌內部引發連鎖反應。效力 27 年的谷歌首席科學家、AI 奠基人 Jeff Dean 近日離職，帶走三名頂尖人才創辦新公司 Discovery Loop，目標直指科研流程自動化與 RSI。
Dean 在離職前受訪時預測，到 2027 年，機器學習系統的自動化程度將大幅提升，透過海量實驗實現自我能力躍升。
RSI 已成為巨頭競逐的新焦點。OpenAI 在 GPT-5.6 發布說明中首次引入「RSI 指數」衡量模型自進化能力，並迎回知名研究員翁荔領導相關團隊。
Anthropic 則披露，藉助 AI 輔助開發，工程師季度代碼交付量較 2021 至 2025 年間增長 8 倍，並預言在充足算力下，AI 完全自主開發後續版本的時代恐快於預期。
興業證券出具最新研報指出，將 RSI 定義為大模型迭代的新主線，並劃分為「合格」、「對等」、「超越」三階段。
儘管當前技術仍處於雛形期，主要體現為代碼生成與有限範圍的自我優化，但 Anthropic 指出，下一代模型重點將是構建「自我迭代循環」。
隨著資本洪流湧入與頂尖人才匯聚，AI 邁向自主進化的臨界點恐比想像中更近。
paras_en: In the face of market skepticism over the return on investment in AI capital expenditures, Alphabet, the parent company of Google, has made a record-breaking debt issuance as its next round of technological bets.

Alphabet recently planned to issue $25 billion in debt, but received over $1.15 trillion in oversubscriptions, with a subscription multiple of 4.6 times, becoming the third-largest transaction in the global investment-grade bond market this year.
The massive amount of capital behind this points to a clear strategic direction that is increasingly evident, namely AI's self-evolution -- recursive self-improvement (RSI).

Google DeepMind's Chief Strategy Officer Jasjeet Sekhon said that the current income generated by AI is still unable to cover the huge capital expenditures, but the risk of not betting on technology at the turning point is even higher.

He pointed out that RSI is the core logic of Alphabet's large capital expenditures. RSI allows AI to autonomously review and optimize its own algorithms, architecture, and training processes, thereby giving birth to even more powerful next-generation models.
Sekhon also compared this to 'manufacturing more advanced steam engines with steam engines', although the technology is still immature, but model-assisted design is already in sight.

This strategic deployment has triggered a chain reaction within Google. Google's 27-year-old Chief Scientist and AI founder Jeff Dean recently left the company, taking three top talents to co-found a new company called Discovery Loop, aiming directly at research process automation and RSI.

Dean predicted in an interview before leaving that by 2027, the degree of automation of machine learning systems will be significantly improved, and self-improvement will be achieved through massive experiments.

RSI has become a new focal point for giants competing with each other. OpenAI introduced the 'RSI Index' to measure model self-evolution ability in the announcement of GPT-5.6, and welcomed back renowned researcher Wang Li to lead the related team.

Anthropic revealed that, with the help of AI-assisted development, engineers' quarterly code delivery volume has increased by 8 times compared to the period from 2021 to 2025, and predicted that the era of AI completely autonomous development of subsequent versions may arrive sooner than expected.
A recent research report from Investment Securities defines RSI as a new mainline of large model iteration and divides it into three stages: 'qualified', 'equal', and 'surpassed'.

Although the current technology is still in its infancy, mainly manifested as code generation and limited self-optimization, Anthropic pointed out that the next-generation model will focus on building a 'self-iterative cycle'.

items.title: 該「賣記憶體、買光通訊」？美光遭砍目標價掀賣壓、祥茂光電財報引爆AI光互連行情
items.title_en: Is It “Sell Memory, Buy Optical Communications”? Micron’s Target Cut Sparks Sell‑off, while Luxshare‑ICT’s Earnings Ignite AI Optical‑Interconnect Rally
paras: 美國股市上週五（7 日）出現一場罕見的類股對決。記憶體概念股全面走軟，光通訊供應鏈卻反向噴出，兩大陣營的表現差異之大，也讓一場「賣記憶體、買光通訊」的交易策略在週末投資圈掀起激辯。
導火線是花旗證券分析師 Atif Malik 發布的最新報告。儘管花旗仍維持美光科技 (MU-US) 「買進」評等，卻將目標價從 1400 美元大砍至 1150 美元。
花旗指出，經與記憶體供應鏈上下游業者交叉查證後研判，DRAM 與 NAND 價格漲勢將在未來四季逐步收斂，並可能於明年 5 月見頂。
報告中花旗進一步預估，未來四個季度 DRAM 價格季增率將依序放緩至 23%、9%、2% 與 0%，2027 下半年甚至可能轉為季減 3%；NAND 方面的季增率則預估為 29%、7%、0% 與 - 1%，下半年跌幅可能擴大至 5%。
花旗將這波降溫歸咎於中國記憶體廠長鑫科技 (688825-CN) 與長江存儲持續擴產所帶來的供給壓力。
受此消息影響，美光股價週五下跌約 1%，SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 重挫逾 2%。跌勢並蔓延至亞股，南韓 SK 海力士 (000660KS) 重挫逾 4%，三星電子 (005930KS) 與日商鎧俠也同步走低。

祥茂光電財報亮眼 光通訊族群集體噴發

與記憶體股形成強烈對比的，是光通訊模組廠祥茂光電 (AAOI-US) 交出亮眼成績單引發光通訊板塊的集體走強。
祥茂光電第二季營收年增 86%，達 1.919 億美元，其中資料中心業務營收首度突破億元大關；非 GAAP 每股純益 0.06 美元，優於財測上緣。
公司並上修財測，預估第三季營收將落在 2.55 億至 2.90 億美元區間，全年目標維持約 11 億美元不變。
消息激勵下，光通訊族群同步走強。康寧 (GLW-US) 股價上漲 5%，Lumentum(LITE-US) 上漲 6%，Coherent(COHR-US) 更是狂飆 13%，祥茂光電本身也大漲 9%。
從產品結構觀察，祥茂光電第二季 400G 產品營收達 4840 萬美元，年增逾四倍；更值得留意的是 800G 產品，單季營收 1280 萬美元，不僅年增逾十倍，季增幅度也達一倍，管理層更預告第三季 800G 營收將較上季再成長近五倍，顯示市場需求正快速從 100G、400G 等舊世代規格，轉向更高速率的新產品。
產能吃緊的訊號同樣明顯。祥茂光電管理層透露，目前客戶下單需求已超出公司實際供應能力達 20% 至 40%，換言之，制約公司成長的已非市場需求，而是產能瓶頸。
目前 800G 與 1.6T 產品月產能已逼近 20 萬片，公司規劃到 2026 年底擴大至 65 萬片以上，2027 年底則要突破 93 萬片。
祥茂光電執行長林誌明更樂觀預期，第四季 1.6T 產品營收可望超過 7000 萬美元，「就算明年首季再翻一倍，我也不會意外」。
不過他同時坦言，1.6T 所需的關鍵零組件 DSP 與 TIA 供應仍相當吃緊，第四季出貨的主要瓶頸來自零組件供應，而非公司自身產能。
市場分析人士認為，祥茂光電這份優於預期的財報，也為即將公布財報的 Lumentum 與 Coherent 注入信心。這兩家公司同樣獲輝達 (NVDA-US) 入股加持，被市場視為 AI 算力基建浪潮下的「賣鏟人」代表。

記憶體多頭陣營內部分裂 周末論戰白熱化

真正引爆週末討論熱度的，是向來看多記憶體股的 Citrini Research 分析師 Jukan 在社群平台 X 上的一篇貼文。
他提出短期內市場或許該考慮「賣記憶體、買光通訊」的操作邏輯，並列出三項理由：

南韓槓桿型 ETF 市場運作機制近期失靈，相關投資人恐面臨贖回壓力，可能對記憶體股帶來額外賣壓；
輝達正調整下一代 AI 系統架構，傳出新款 Rubin Ultra 晶片可能減少每機櫃搭載的高頻寬記憶體（HBM）數量，轉而仰賴光互連技術串接多個機櫃；
市場對記憶體價格將在未來兩季見頂的預期正持續升溫。


值得注意的是，Jukan 強調自己對記憶體股的長期看法仍屬正面，僅是短期轉趨謹慎。
他認為，AI 基礎建設的投資重心正從單純堆疊 HBM 容量，轉向講究資料中心整體架構效率，而高速光互連正是這波轉型的關鍵環節。
這番言論隨即引來活躍於社群媒體 X 的匿名 AI 與半導體供應鏈研究員、投資人 Serenity 的正面反駁，他重申自己仍堅定「看多」記憶體族群。
Serenity 的核心論點在於：真正改變的是股價，而非基本面。
他指出，Coherent 與 Lumentum 的雷射元件早在 7 月股價重挫時，未來兩年產能便已銷售一空；祥茂光電供需失衡的狀況，其實在上一季法說會上便已明確揭露，換言之整個 7 月暴跌期間，這些公司的基本面未曾惡化，「變的只是清算賣壓過後的股價」。
他也諷刺，不少投資人在祥茂光電股價跌到 75 美元時直呼是「騙局一場」，如今股價漲到 140 美元卻又轉向看多，「但光收發器與磷化銦基板的產能瓶頸根本沒變，情況甚至可能更嚴重」。
至於記憶體股，Serenity 觀察到近期出現大量散戶恐慌性拋售，但他反問，「同樣是這批人，一個月前不是還在為美光簽下 16 份供應合約、三星繳出歷史新高的營業利益歡呼喝采嗎？」
他認為，輝達針對 Rubin Ultra 進行的儲存配置優化，不過是該公司每一代產品都會進行的例行調整，而當前記憶體類股市值相對其營業利益水準而言「明顯偏低到不合理」，尤其在記憶體需求逐漸轉為結構性成長的背景下，明年供需失衡的情況恐怕只會更加嚴峻。
Serenity 在貼文中總結道：「祥茂光電在 140 美元和 75 美元時，都是同一家公司；三星市值 1.5 兆美元和 9800 億美元時，也還是同一家公司。真正改變的只有估值與市場敘事，而這通常只是雜訊，市場不過是在類股之間輪動而已。」
paras_en: Last Friday (the 7th), the US stock market saw a rare sector showdown. Memory‑related stocks fell across the board, while the optical‑communications supply chain surged, and the stark contrast between the two camps sparked a heated debate over a “sell memory, buy optical communications” strategy over the weekend.
The spark was a new report from Citi analyst Atif Malik. Although Citi still rates Micron Technology (MU‑US) as a “Buy,” it slashed the target price from $1,400 to $1,150.

Citi said that, after cross‑checking with upstream and downstream players in the memory supply chain, it expects DRAM and NAND price gains to gradually taper off over the next four quarters and possibly peak by May next year.

The report further projects quarterly DRAM price growth rates to slow to 23%, 9%, 2% and 0% over the next four quarters, with a possible 3% quarterly decline in the second half of 2027; NAND’s quarterly growth is forecast at 29%, 7%, 0% and –1%, with the second‑half decline potentially widening to 5%.
Citi attributes the cooling to supply pressure from China’s memory makers ChangXin Technology (688825‑CN) and Yangtze Memory Technologies expanding capacity.

Following the news, Micron fell about 1% on Friday and SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) plunged more than 2%. The decline spilled into Asian markets, with South Korea’s SK Hynix (000660KS) down over 4%, and Samsung Electronics (005930KS) and Japan’s Kioxia also slipping.

In stark contrast to the memory stocks, optical‑communications module maker Luxshare‑ICT (AAOI‑US) posted an eye‑catching earnings report that sparked a rally across the optical‑communications sector.

Luxshare‑ICT’s Q2 revenue jumped 86% year‑on‑year to $191.9 million, with data‑center revenue breaking the $100 million mark for the first time; non‑GAAP EPS was $0.06, beating the upper end of forecasts.
The company also raised its outlook, forecasting Q3 revenue between $255 million and $290 million, while keeping the full‑year target around $1.1 billion.
On the back of the news, the optical‑communications group rallied: Corning (GLW‑US) rose 5%, Lumentum (LITE‑US) 6%, Coherent (COHR‑US) surged 13%, and Luxshare‑ICT itself jumped 9%.

Looking at product mix, Luxshare‑ICT’s Q2 400G product revenue reached $48.4 million, more than four‑fold year‑on‑year; its 800G line generated $12.8 million in the quarter, up over ten‑fold YoY and doubling QoQ, with management forecasting Q3 800G revenue to grow nearly five‑fold versus the prior quarter, indicating rapid demand shift from older 100G/400G specs to higher‑speed offerings.
Capacity constraints are also evident. Management said current customer orders exceed the company’s supply capability by 20%‑40%, meaning growth is now limited by capacity rather than demand.
The monthly capacity for 800G and 1.6T products is already near 200,000 units; the firm plans to expand to over 650,000 units by end‑2026 and beyond 930,000 units by end‑2027.
CEO Lin Chih‑ming is even more upbeat, expecting Q4 1.6T product revenue to exceed $70 million, adding “even if it doubles in Q1 next year, I won’t be surprised.”
He cautioned, however, that key components for 1.6T—DSPs and TIAs—remain tight, and the main bottleneck for Q4 shipments will be component supply, not the company’s own fab capacity.

Analysts say Luxshare‑ICT’s better‑than‑expected results boost confidence ahead of earnings from Lumentum and Coherent, both of which have Nvidia (NVDA‑US) stakes and are seen as “shovel‑owners” in the AI compute‑infrastructure wave.
The weekend debate heated up after a post on X by Citrine Research analyst Jukan, a long‑time bullish voice on memory stocks.

He suggested a short‑term “sell memory, buy optical communications” play, citing three reasons: South Korean leveraged‑ETF markets are malfunctioning, potentially forcing redemptions that could add sell pressure on memory stocks; Nvidia is tweaking its next‑gen AI system architecture, with rumors that the new Rubin Ultra chip may cut the number of high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) modules per rack and rely more on optical interconnects; and market expectations that memory prices will peak within the next two quarters are heating up.
Jukan stressed that his long‑term view on memory stocks remains positive; he is merely more cautious in the short run.

He argued that AI infrastructure investment is shifting from simply stacking HBM capacity to optimizing overall data‑center architecture efficiency, with high‑speed optical interconnects being the key enabler of this transition.
The comments were promptly countered by an anonymous AI and semiconductor‑supply‑chain researcher‑investor named Serenity on X, who reaffirmed a bullish stance on the memory sector.
Serenity’s core point: it’s the stock price, not the fundamentals, that’s changing.

He noted that Coherent’s and Lumentum’s laser components were already sold out for the next two years when their shares plunged in July, and that Luxshare‑ICT’s supply‑demand imbalance had been clearly disclosed at the previous quarter’s earnings call—meaning the fundamentals didn’t deteriorate during July’s crash; only the price adjusted after sell‑off pressure.

He also mocked investors who called Luxshare‑ICT a “scam” when its shares fell to $75, only to turn bullish as the price rose to $140, saying the capacity bottlenecks for optical transceivers and indium‑phosphide substrates remain unchanged, perhaps even worse.

Regarding memory stocks, Serenity observed a wave of panic selling by retail investors, but asked, “Were these same people cheering a month ago when Micron signed 16 supply contracts and Samsung posted record operating profit?”

He believes Nvidia’s storage‑configuration tweaks for Rubin Ultra are routine product‑generation adjustments, and that memory‑sector valuations are “clearly too low relative to earnings,” especially as memory demand moves toward structural growth; the supply‑demand gap is likely to tighten further next year.

Serenity summed up in his post: “Luxshare‑ICT at $140 and at $75 is the same company; Samsung at a $1.5 trillion market cap and at $980 billion is still the same company. What really changes is valuation and market narrative, which are often just noise—markets are simply rotating between sectors.”

items.title: 美國政府「不會」允許市場崩盤？美銀Hartnett「短空長多」、點牛市終結「兩訊號」
items.title_en: U.S. Government Won't Let Markets Crash? BofA's Hartnett Calls for Short-Term Shorts, Long-Term Longs, and Flags Two Signals Ending the Bull Market
paras: 美銀策略師哈奈特（Michael Hartnett）對美股後市給出「短空長多」判斷，認為市場情緒已過度亢奮，信用市場也浮現警訊，短線宜降低風險部位；但他同時強調，只要美國決策當局持續將股市視為「大到不能倒」的系統性資產，長線做多股票、放空債券的策略便不會改變，並認為「殖利率走高、銀行股下跌」才是本輪牛市真正反轉的關鍵訊號。
哈奈特在最新一期「Flow Show」報告中指出，這波牛市之所以難以被撼動，關鍵在於美國經濟已高度仰賴股市所帶動的財富效應。
美國家庭今年以來股票資產已增值 7 兆美元，延續 2024 與 2025 年各增加 9 兆美元的走勢，加上 AI 資料中心資本支出熱潮，共同構成當局不願、也不敢坐視股市重挫的結構性理由。
他並提到，上週外匯市場出現協調式干預、平息一場他稱之為「窮人版 LTCM」的去槓桿賣壓，正是美國政府隨時準備出手護盤的最新證明，且川普政府與財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）手中仍握有殖利率曲線控制這項政策工具作為後盾。
不過，哈奈特並未因此轉為全面樂觀。他觀察到，受高收益債券大規模資金流入、全球高收益債及 AT1 風險債券利差收窄，以及全球股票指數廣度改善等因素驅動，美銀牛熊指標已從 9.4 升至 9.7，創下 2021 年迷因股狂潮以來新高。
哈奈特指出，歷史上每當美銀牛熊指標觸及類似極值，無論是 2018 年、2020 年還是 2021 年，市場情緒往往在此後一年內從極度樂觀迅速逆轉至極度悲觀。
儘管他並未斷言歷史必然重演，但明確提示這一規律值得警惕。
基於這項判斷，哈奈特在戰術操作上仍主張「夏季撤退與資產輪動」，建議資金轉向必需消費品等防禦型類股，以及 REITs、小型股、生技股等對利率較敏感的存續期資產，並提高美元部位。
他解釋，這類資產較能承受金融環境收緊的衝擊，一旦「總體經濟不衰退、聯準會不升息、AI 資本支出不縮減、期中選舉不過度躁進」這套市場普遍押注的樂觀劇本落空，受到的傷害也會比銀行、工業與半導體等景氣循環類股輕。
在宏觀數據層面，哈奈特先前亦預判，若 7 月非農就業人數超過 12.5 萬且失業率低於 4.1%，聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）可能在 8 月 28 日 Jackson Hole 全球央行年會上重回鷹派立場；而若非農數據低於 5 萬且失業率超過 4.3%，則將利期資產和防禦性配置。
最終公佈的數據呈現出混合訊號。非農業數據大幅不及預期，但失業率降至 4.1%，部分抵消了負面衝擊，儘管勞動力人口在同一時期萎縮了 26.4 萬人。
至於這波牛市真正終結的關鍵訊號，哈奈特亦給出明確答案:「殖利率上升、銀行股下跌」。
他警告，一旦債券市場出現「殖利率走高、美元走弱」的債券自衛式拋售，迫使財政政策緊急轉向，並帶動資金從股票轉向債券，繁榮格局便可能劃下句點。
哈奈特也點出信用市場的隱憂。AI 超大規模資料中心營運商的信用利差與 CDS 持續走闊，主因企業回購動能減弱，唯有科技七巨頭本季每股盈餘總和超過 70 美元，才能化解「中國低價算力終結 AI 資本支出熱潮」的疑慮。
報告最後，哈奈特將視角拉高至政治經濟框架。
他指出，2020 年代民粹主義浪潮推動財政擴張，使美國名目 GDP 六年間成長 63% 至 32 兆美元，美國國債規模也將突破 40 兆美元。
哈奈特將即將到來的期中選舉定調為「以成長降赤字」與「以財富稅降赤字」兩條路線之爭。
他認為，若共和黨保住參議院多數席次將是利多，做多消費股是押注川普政府轉向聚焦民生可負擔性，而做多黃金則是對沖選民結構「K 型分化」風險、避免年底前殖利率、美元與股市同步重挫的有效工具。
paras_en: BofA strategist Michael Hartnett judges the U.S. equity outlook as "short-term short, long-term long," believing market sentiment is overly exuberant and credit markets are showing warning signs, so short‑term risk should be reduced; however, he stresses that as long as U.S. policymakers continue to treat the stock market as a systemically important asset that "cannot fail," a strategy of buying stocks for the long run and shorting bonds will remain unchanged, and he sees "rising yields and falling bank stocks" as the true reversal signal for this bull run.
Hartnett notes in the latest "Flow Show" report that the resilience of the current bull market hinges on the U.S. economy’s heavy reliance on the wealth effect generated by equities.

U.S. households have seen their stock holdings increase by $7 trillion so far this year, continuing a trend of $9 trillion gains in both 2024 and 2025, and together with the AI data‑center capital‑expenditure boom provides a structural reason why authorities are unwilling—and unable—to stand by a sharp market decline.

He adds that last week coordinated FX intervention quelled a de‑leveraging sell‑off he dubbed a "poor‑man’s LTCM," which he sees as fresh proof that the U.S. government is ready to step in, and that the Trump administration and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent still hold yield‑curve control as a policy backstop.

Nevertheless, Hartnett is not wholly optimistic. He observes that massive inflows into high‑yield bonds, narrowing spreads on global high‑yield and AT1 risk bonds, and an improving breadth of global equity indices have pushed BofA’s bull‑bear index from 9.4 to 9.7, a peak not seen since the meme‑stock frenzy of 2021.

Hartnett points out that historically, whenever the BofA bull‑bear index reaches such extreme levels—whether in 2018, 2020 or 2021—market sentiment typically flips from extreme optimism to extreme pessimism within a year.
While he does not claim history must repeat itself, he warns that this pattern deserves close attention.

Based on this view, Hartnett still recommends a "summer retreat and asset rotation" tactically, shifting capital toward defensive sectors such as consumer staples, as well as REITs, small‑caps and biotech—assets more sensitive to interest‑rate duration—and increasing dollar exposure.

He explains that these assets can better withstand a tightening financial environment, and if the broadly‑bet optimistic script—no recession, no Fed rate hikes, sustained AI cap‑ex, and a calm midterm election—fails, they would suffer less than cyclical stocks like banks, industrials and semiconductors.

On the macro side, Hartnett previously forecast that if July non‑farm payrolls exceed 125,000 and unemployment falls below 4.1%, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh could revert to a hawkish stance at the August 28 Jackson Hole central‑bank symposium; conversely, if payrolls are under 50,000 and unemployment rises above 4.3%, investors should tilt toward rate‑sensitive and defensive holdings.

The actual data delivered mixed signals: non‑farm payrolls fell far short of expectations, but the unemployment rate dropped to 4.1%, partially offsetting the downside, even as the labor‑force participation declined by 264,000 in the same period.
Regarding the decisive signal that the bull market is truly ending, Hartnett states plainly: "Rising yields and falling bank stocks."

He warns that if the bond market initiates a self‑defensive sell‑off—higher yields and a weaker dollar—forcing fiscal policy to shift abruptly and prompting a flow from equities to bonds, the prosperity cycle could be capped.

Hartnett also highlights a credit‑market concern: credit spreads and CDS on ultra‑large AI data‑center operators are widening because corporate buybacks are slowing, and only if the seven major tech firms collectively post earnings above $70 per share this quarter can the worry that "low‑cost Chinese compute will end the AI cap‑ex boom" be allayed.
In the report’s final section, Hartnett lifts the perspective to a political‑economic framework.
He notes that the populist wave of the 2020s has driven fiscal expansion, boosting nominal U.S. GDP by 63% to $32 trillion over six years, while sovereign debt is set to surpass $40 trillion.
Hartnett frames the upcoming midterm elections as a contest between two deficit‑reduction paths: "growth‑driven deficit reduction" versus "wealth‑tax‑driven deficit reduction."

He believes that if Republicans retain a Senate majority it will be bullish, as going long on consumer stocks bets on a Trump administration refocusing on affordable living, while going long on gold hedges the "K‑shaped" voter‑base risk and protects against a simultaneous plunge in yields, the dollar and equities before year‑end.

items.title: 美股壞消息不斷卻「越漲越勇」！資金湧入半導體、高收益債與比特幣
paras: 半導體股重挫、公債殖利率居高不下、地緣政治風險未解，華爾街近來壞消息不斷，但資金流向說的卻是完全不同的故事。美股創新高之際，資金同步湧入高收益債與比特幣 ETF，推升美銀牛熊指標至 2021 年以來高點，市場情緒明顯升溫。
上週，標普 500 指數改寫歷史新高，那斯達克 100 指數繳出近兩個月最亮眼的單週表現；同一時間，高收益債券基金單週吸金達 40 億美元、創下近兩年新高，比特幣相關 ETF 五個交易日內也淨流入 5 億美元。
美銀「牛熊指標」隨之攀升至 2021 年以來的最高點，顯示市場情緒已明顯轉向樂觀。
這波樂觀情緒，正好發生在一場戲劇性事件之後。由有「矽谷股神」之稱的 Leopold Aschenbrenner 所創立的 AI 主題避險基金 Situational Awareness 爆倉，一度將費城半導體指數自六月高點拖低 29%。
然而市場並未如過往般選擇避險撤退，反倒把這場動盪當成進場訊號。短短兩個交易日內，每日 3 倍看多半導體 ETF(SOXL-US) 便湧入逾 20 億美元資金，隨後七個交易日累計漲幅超過 50%。
兩檔規模最大的非槓桿半導體 ETF 同期也合計吸金逾 70 億美元，各自上漲約 16%。整體而言，半導體相關槓桿與非槓桿基金上週合計吸引超過 110 億美元資金。
JonesTrading 首席市場策略師 Michael O"Rourke 將這股買氣形容為動能買盤掀起的「海嘯」，但他也提醒，不少資金依然集中在市值最大的幾檔科技股上，真正撐起指數漲勢的主力仍是七巨頭。

從股市到債市、加密貨幣，風險偏好全面回溫

分析人士指出，推升行情的不只是晶片股，而是跨資產類別的全面資金涌入。
根據美銀統計，高收益債券基金上週淨流入 40 億美元，創下兩年來單週新高；比特幣 ETF 儘管幣價已橫盤數月，五個交易日內仍吸金 5 億美元。
美銀牛熊指標因此升至 2021 年來高點，策略師 Michael Hartnett 團隊的分析指出，漲勢已從科技股核心板塊擴散開來，加上高收益債資金強勁、信用利差收窄，共同撐起了這股樂觀氛圍。
Natixis Investment Managers Solutions 投資組合策略師 Garrett Melson 則認為，眼下市場的疑慮被過度放大，風險資產基本面其實穩固。
他目前維持美股超配、聚焦大型科技股的部位，固定收益則相對低配。
Melson 強調，整體經濟表現依然良好，情緒與部位有時會過度延伸，但這種過熱只是局部現象, 類股輪動反而有助於消化泡沫、同時支撐大盤。

殖利率仍居高不下，成為最大隱憂

不過這場多頭盛宴並非毫無陰影。30 年期美債殖利率雖然近五個交易日有四天回落，但仍徘徊在近二十年高點附近，成為市場揮之不去的壓力來源。
至於殖利率為何居高不下，市場看法分歧。
一派認為 7 月底的飆升，是因為聯準會（Fed）主席華許（Kevin Warsh）未能給出明確的利率指引，讓外界對其抗通膨決心產生疑慮；另一派則認為，這其實反映投資人對經濟持續擴張的信心。
上週五公布的美國 7 月就業數據意外轉弱，加上前兩月數據下修，反而提振了股市、壓低了殖利率，市場因此押注聯準會短期內不至於被迫升息。
高盛資產管理的 Lindsay Rosner 指出，隨著數據逐漸明朗、油價趨穩，經濟全貌以及資本支出的回報率也變得更清晰，整體經濟依然強勁，市場正在消化 AI 相關的供給變化。
Wealth Enhancement 資深投資策略師 Ayako Yoshioka 則提醒，半導體雖仍是 AI 基礎建設的核心，但接下來的瓶頸恐怕會轉移到電力供應不足，而殖利率走高本身，仍是必須留意的風險。

每次回調都被視為買點，多頭信心愈戰愈強

分析指出，支撐這波風險偏好的，還有一種在市場上一再被驗證的心理慣性，即每次拉回都很短暫，每次恐慌都是進場機會。
Manulife Investment Management 資深投資組合經理 Nathan Thooft 觀察到，價格修正一再證明只是曇花一現，這種經驗不斷強化投資人的信心；反倒是在不確定性最高時選擇出場的人，往往錯過隨後最強勁的反彈。
Thooft 直言，現金雖然感覺安全，長期卻難以跑贏通膨與股市的獲利成長。他認為過去十年，那些一直等待更理想進場時機的投資人，大多已被市場拋在後頭。
市場情緒的快速修復，也反映在波動率指標上。芝加哥選擇權交易所（Cboe）半導體 ETF 波動率指數本週下滑近 9 個點，創下今年最大單週跌幅。儘管風險清單仍在拉長，但資金的實際流向，顯然仍指向風險資產。

items.title: SK海力士單周大跌15%！里昂證券：最壞情況已過 股東回報更清晰 維持「跑贏大盤」評等
items.title_en: SK Hynix Plunges 15% in a Week! CLSA: The Worst-Case Scenario Has Passed, Shareholder Returns Become Clearer, Maintaining "Outperform the Market" Rating
paras: 里昂證券 (CLSA) 出具最新報告指出，SK 海力士上週五 (7 日) 盤後宣布積極檢討強化股東價值措施，並將於第三季內公布細節，此舉直接回應市場對其今年次季財報會議「缺乏明確資本配置指引」的不滿，而這正是近期股價偏弱的主因之一。
里昂認為，受惠 AI 伺服器帶動 HBM 出貨，到 2028 年，SK 海力士獲利能力與自由現金流將維持極強勁狀態，今年股東回報規模有望突破 100 兆韓元 (含分紅與回購)，規模較往年大幅躍升，不僅實質增厚股東價值，更可能成為股價重估的催化劑。
因此，里昂維持對 SK 海力士「高度確信跑贏大盤」評級，目標價 370 萬韓元不變。
針對近期市場對「SK 海力士與輝達 HBM4 價格談判 ASP 漲幅恐落後同業」的疑慮，里昂反向解讀指出，SK 海力士 HBM4 的核心晶粒與基底晶粒部分採舊製程生產，成本結構顯著低於對手，即便最終成交價低於市場預期，毛利率仍有望優於同業，保住 HBM 龍頭的獲利護城河。
里昂在報告中也指出，在 AI 資本支出週期未歇、HBM4 量產放量的背景下，SK 海力士正從「週期股」切換至「高現金回報成長股」敘事，待今年第三季股東回報方案落地，估值壓制可望鬆動。市場短期糾結於定價邊際放緩，但里昂看的是該公司 2026–2028 年自由現金流兌現以及資本返還的雙重確定性。
paras_en: CLSA has released its latest report, stating that SK Hynix announced on Friday (7th) after the market close that it will actively review and strengthen shareholder value measures, with details to be disclosed in the third quarter. This move directly responds to market dissatisfaction with the lack of clear capital allocation guidance at its annual general meeting this year, which is one of the main reasons for the recent weakness in stock prices.

CLSA believes that, driven by AI server-driven HBM shipments, SK Hynix's profitability and free cash flow will remain extremely strong until 2028. This year's shareholder returns are expected to exceed 100 trillion KRW (including dividends and buybacks), a significant increase from previous years, not only increasing shareholder value but also potentially becoming a catalyst for revaluation.
Therefore, CLSA maintains its "highly confident outperform the market" rating for SK Hynix, with a target price of 370 million KRW unchanged.

In response to market concerns about "SK Hynix's HBM4 price negotiations with Micron and the ASP increase may lag behind the industry", CLSA reverses the interpretation, pointing out that SK Hynix's HBM4 core particles and base particles are produced using an old process, resulting in a significantly lower cost structure than its competitors. Even if the final transaction price is lower than expected, the gross margin is expected to be higher than the industry average, preserving the profitability moat of HBM leader.

CLSA also pointed out in the report that, in the background of AI capital expenditures not yet subsiding and HBM4 mass production, SK Hynix is transitioning from a "cyclical stock" to a "high cash return growth stock" narrative. As the shareholder return scheme is expected to be implemented in the third quarter, the valuation pressure is expected to ease. While the market is short-term entangled in the pricing margin slowdown, CLSA looks at the company's 2026-2028 free cash flow realization and capital return certainty.

items.title: 砸1兆日元！索尼傳攜手台積電日本建廠 攻機器人、車用次世代感測器
items.title_en: Sony and TSMC to Invest ¥1 Trillion in Japan Factory for Robots and Next-Gen Sensors
paras: 彭博引述消息人士報導，索尼 (SONY-US) 與台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 正針對在日本合資建廠一案進行協商，雙方預計將共同斥資達 1 兆日元（約 64 億美元）。
消息人士表示，索尼旗下半導體事業「索尼半導體解決方案公司」將與台積電攜手合作，鎖定車用與機器人領域，共同開發次世代影像感測器。對此，索尼與台積電均未回應置評請求。
這項正在討論中的投資計畫，此前已由《日本經濟新聞》報導。這也是索尼影像感測器業務朝向「輕資產化」策略轉型的最新布局。近年來，索尼逐步將更多資源投入音樂發行權、電影內容以及遊戲 IP 等智慧財產領域。
消息公布後，索尼股價週一 (10 日) 早盤一度上漲 2.2%，台積電股價也上漲 1.7%。
報導稱，該合資計畫將落腳於日本九州熊本縣，亦即台積電日本晶圓廠的所在地。雙方先前曾表示，若能進一步獲得日本政府的政策補貼與支持，未來不排除擴大廠區規模。
索尼雖僅為台積電熊本廠的少數股東，但在此次新成立的合資公司中，索尼將取得主導權成為控股大股東。
總部位於東京的索尼，長期以來穩居蘋果 (AAPL-US) 、華為與三星電子 (005930KS) 等指標大廠的高階影像感測器主力供應商。近期，該公司更積極拓展業務版圖，力拚將感測元件技術延伸至車載應用與機器人等新興市場。
paras_en: Sony Corp (SONY-US) and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (2330-TW)(TSM-US) are in talks to jointly build a factory in Japan, with the two companies expected to invest a combined ¥1 trillion ($7.9 billion), according to people familiar with the matter.

The two companies plan to collaborate on developing next-generation image sensors for the automotive and robotics markets through Sony's semiconductor unit, Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corp, the people said. Sony and TSMC declined to comment on the matter.

The investment plan, which was previously reported by the Nikkei newspaper, is part of Sony's strategy to shift its image sensor business towards a 'light asset' approach. In recent years, Sony has been investing more resources in music publishing rights, film content, and gaming IP.
Sony's shares rose 2.2% in early trading on Monday, while TSMC's shares gained 1.7% after the news was reported.

The joint venture is expected to be located in Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan, where TSMC has a chip factory. The two companies have previously said they would consider expanding the factory's scale if they receive policy support from the Japanese government.
Sony, which owns a small stake in TSMC's Kumamoto factory, will become the majority shareholder of the new joint venture, giving it control over the company.

Sony, based in Tokyo, has long been a major supplier of high-end image sensors to companies like Apple Inc (AAPL-US), Huawei Technologies Co and Samsung Electronics Co (005930KS). The company has been actively expanding its business into new areas, including automotive and robotics applications.

items.title: iPhone 17要漲價了？傳蘋果最快8/10調高售價、記憶體成本飆升成關鍵
items.title_en: iPhone 17 May See Price Hike: Apple to Raise Prices as Early as August 10, Memory Costs Soar
paras: 根據最新傳聞，蘋果 (AAPL-US) 最快可能在本週一（10 日）調高 iPhone 17 售價，時間點甚至早於外界預期的下一波漲價，而更大規模的價格調整則預計將伴隨下月 iPhone 18 Pro 上市登場。
根據《MacRumors》報導，微博爆料帳號「Fixed Focus Digital」昨日發文表示，市場目前流傳 iPhone 17 將於 10 日起調整價格的消息。
不過，該爆料者並未明確表示價格是否真的會上調；相較之下，貼文較為確定地指出，蘋果已取消部分生產線將產能由原本增加 15% 至 30% 的計畫。
目前尚不清楚該貼文所指的產能調整，具體涉及哪些零組件或產品。
基於記憶體與儲存元件成本大幅上升，蘋果今年 6 月已調高 Mac、iPad 及多數其他產品的售價，但 iPhone、Apple Watch、AirPods、Studio Display 及配件則未受影響。
市場目前普遍傳言，蘋果下一波價格調整將以 iPhone 18 Pro 為主。
蘋果預計將於下月推出 iPhone 18 Pro、iPhone 18 Pro Max，以及首款折疊 iPhone；至於標準版 iPhone 18 與 iPhone 18e，則要等到 2027 年春季才會上市。
預計 iPhone 17 至少到明年仍將是蘋果的主流機型，可能成為蘋果在新一代產品上市前，單獨調整 iPhone 17 售價的充分理由。
若漲價成真，目前仍無法確定蘋果調高 iPhone 17 售價是否會涵蓋整個產品線，包括售價 599 美元的 iPhone 17e、799 美元的 iPhone 17、999 美元的 iPhone Air、1,099 美元的 iPhone 17 Pro，以及 1,199 美元的 iPhone 17 Pro Max，抑或僅有部分機型受到影響。
paras_en: According to the latest rumors, Apple (AAPL-US) may raise the price of iPhone 17 as early as August 10, beating the expected price hike cycle, and a more significant price adjustment is expected to accompany the release of iPhone 18 Pro next month.
A report by MacRumors cites a Weibo account called 'Fixed Focus Digital' stating that the market is circulating rumors that iPhone 17 will adjust its price starting from August 10.

However, the whistleblower did not explicitly confirm whether the price will indeed be raised; instead, the post is more certain that Apple has canceled plans to increase production capacity by 15% to 30%.
It is unclear which components or products are involved in the production adjustment mentioned in the post.

Given the significant increase in memory and storage component costs, Apple raised the prices of Mac, iPad, and most other products in June, but iPhone, Apple Watch, AirPods, Studio Display, and accessories were not affected.
The market is currently speculating that Apple's next price hike will focus on iPhone 18 Pro.
Apple plans to release iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and the first foldable iPhone next month, while the standard iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e will be released in the spring of 2027.

It is expected that iPhone 17 will remain Apple's mainstream model at least until next year and may be a sufficient reason for Apple to adjust the price of iPhone 17 before the release of new products.

If the price hike is confirmed, it is still unclear whether Apple will raise the prices of all iPhone models, including the iPhone 17e ($599), iPhone 17 ($799), iPhone Air ($999), iPhone 17 Pro ($1,099), and iPhone 17 Pro Max ($1,199), or only some models will be affected.

items.title: 日元只是暫時穩住 中期選舉後才是真正壓力測試
items.title_en: Yen Stabilizes Temporarily, Real Pressure Test to Come After Midterm Elections
paras: 美日聯手干預外匯市場後，日元近期暫時止跌回穩，但這場救市行動背後的目的，可能不只是穩定匯率。
前華爾街基金經理、宏觀分析師 Ed Dowd 認為，此次干預時點與美國中期選舉高度吻合，核心考量之一，是避免日元持續貶值迫使日本拋售逾 1 兆美元美債，進而推升美債殖利率，在政治敏感期引發金融市場與經濟動盪。
問題是，美日利差等結構性矛盾並未解決，一旦中期選舉落幕、政治護盤動力消退，日元能否守住目前水準，將成為下一階段市場焦點。
干預短期奏效 長期效果仍存疑
這波聯合干預已迅速反映在匯市。日元自 163.65 的低點回升至 159.09 附近，創下 2 月以來最大單週漲幅。美國財長貝森特（Scott Bessent）8 月 2 日也公開證實美日協調行動，並表明美方不會猶豫參與進一步的聯合干預。
不過，市場人士普遍認為，單靠外匯干預仍屬治標不治本。歷史經驗顯示，如果官方干預缺乏基本面政策配合，效果往往難以持久，且隨著干預次數增加，所需規模可能愈來愈大，邊際效果卻逐漸遞減。
Dowd 警告，如果日本政策沒有持續跟進，日元最終仍可能重新走弱，迫使當局採取規模更大、頻率更高的干預，而每一輪行動也會提高資產價格劇烈波動與流動性事件發生的風險。
救日元背後 更要防美債遭拋售
要理解這波干預的深層邏輯，關鍵在於日本持有大量美國國債。日本是美債最大境外持有國之一，持有規模超過 1 兆美元。當日元大幅貶值，日本當局為捍衛本幣，可能面臨動用外匯存底、出售美債的壓力，進而直接推升美債殖利率。
在美國財政赤字居高不下之際，美債殖利率若快速攀升，可能帶來更棘手的後果。因此，從這個角度來看，這次干預的直接導火線，更可能是日元貶值帶來的美債拋售風險，而非單純為日元護盤。
貝森特也援引亞洲金融危機經驗指出，日元極度疲弱可能產生外溢效應，因此與其等到危機爆發，不如提前採取行動。
路透報導，美國財政部在干預前已透過紐約聯準銀行通知多家銀行，要求隨時準備因應後續行動，也凸顯這次干預具有高度協調性。
FIMA 擴容 降低美債賣壓
此次行動另一項關鍵，在於貝森特明確支持擴大 FIMA（外國和國際貨幣當局）回購便利規模。
透過這項機制，日本等外國央行可以將持有的美國國債作為抵押，向聯準會取得美元流動性，不必直接把美債拋售至公開市場。
分析人士認為，這項安排等同透過美債換取美元，降低市場上的美債賣壓，進一步抑制殖利率上行壓力。
日元不能太弱 也不能升太快
干預也帶來另一項風險，那就是規模龐大的日元套利交易。
長期以來，低利率日元被大量用作融資貨幣，投資人借入日元後轉進高利率貨幣及資產。一旦日元快速升值，融資成本隨之攀升，可能迫使套利部位大規模平倉，進而衝擊全球股票、債券及其他風險性資產。
2024 年 8 月就是近期案例，當時日元短時間內升值約 10%，日本股市及全球風險資產隨即劇烈震盪。
這次干預已帶動日元升值約 5%，市場目前反應仍相對平穩，但後續走勢仍存在風險。
這也讓美日當局陷入兩難：既不能讓日元持續貶值，迫使日本出售美債；又不能讓日元升值太快，以免觸發套利交易連鎖平倉。
中期選舉後 真正考驗才開始
更大的問題在於，這次干預並未解決日元疲弱的結構性因素。日本長期維持超寬鬆貨幣政策，與聯準會之間存在明顯利差，這才是持續壓低日元的重要力量。
同時，日本公共債務占 GDP 比率高居全球前列，財政空間有限，也使日本央行推動政策正常化面臨諸多限制。如果日本央行無法持續升息、財政紀律又沒有明顯改善，日元最終仍可能重新面臨貶值壓力。
而真正的變數可能出現在美國中期選舉之後。若此次干預確實帶有維持選前市場穩定的政治考量，選舉結束後，推動美日聯手護盤的政治意願是否仍然存在，將成為關鍵。
屆時，若日本自身的結構性問題依舊未解，而這波干預帶來的效果逐漸消退，市場面對的壓力可能比現在更加嚴峻。
換言之，日元目前或許只是暫時穩住，真正的壓力測試，恐怕要等到中期選舉之後才會到來。
paras_en: After the US and Japan jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market, the yen has temporarily stabilized in recent times, but the purpose behind this rescue effort may not be just to stabilize the exchange rate.

Ed Dowd, a former Wall Street fund manager and macro analyst, believes that the timing of this intervention coincides with the US midterm elections, and one of the core considerations is to avoid a continuous depreciation of the yen forcing Japan to sell over $1 trillion in US debt, thereby pushing up US Treasury yields and causing financial market and economic turmoil in a politically sensitive period.

The problem is that the structural contradictions, such as the interest rate differential, have not been resolved, and once the midterm elections are over and the political protectionist momentum is lost, whether the yen can maintain its current level will become the next market focus.
The intervention has had a short-term effect, but its long-term effectiveness is still uncertain.

This joint intervention has quickly reflected in the market. The yen has risen from a low of 163.65 to around 159.09, creating a 2-month single-week gain. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent also publicly confirmed the US-Japan coordination action on August 2 and stated that the US will not hesitate to participate in further joint interventions.

However, market participants generally believe that relying solely on foreign exchange intervention is a palliative rather than a cure. Historical experience shows that if official intervention lacks basic policy support, the effect is often difficult to sustain, and as the number of interventions increases, the required scale may become larger, but the marginal effect will gradually decrease.

Dowd warned that if Japan's policies do not continue to follow up, the yen may eventually weaken again, forcing authorities to take larger-scale and more frequent interventions, and each round of action will increase the risk of asset price volatility and liquidity events.
The logic behind this rescue is not just to save the yen, but also to prevent US debt from being sold.

To understand the deeper logic of this intervention, the key lies in Japan's holding of a large amount of US debt. Japan is one of the largest foreign holders of US debt, with a holding size of over $1 trillion. When the yen depreciates sharply, the Japanese authorities may face pressure to use foreign exchange reserves and sell US debt, thereby directly pushing up US Treasury yields.

In a situation where the US fiscal deficit is high, if US Treasury yields rise rapidly, it may lead to more complicated consequences. Therefore, from this perspective, the direct trigger of this intervention is more likely to be the risk of US debt sales caused by yen depreciation, rather than simply protecting the yen.

Bessent also cited the experience of the Asian financial crisis, saying that a severely weak yen may have a spillover effect, so it's better to take action in advance rather than waiting for a crisis to break out.

Reuters reported that the US Treasury Department had notified several banks through the New York Federal Reserve before the intervention, asking them to be prepared for subsequent actions, highlighting the high degree of coordination of this intervention.
FIMA expansion reduces US debt selling pressure
Another key aspect of this action is that Bessent has explicitly supported the expansion of the FIMA (Foreign and International Monetary Authorities) repurchase facility.

Through this mechanism, foreign central banks, including Japan, can use US debt as collateral to obtain US dollars from the Federal Reserve, without having to sell US debt directly to the open market.

Analysts believe that this arrangement is equivalent to exchanging US debt for US dollars, reducing the selling pressure on US debt in the market, and further suppressing the upward pressure on yields.
The yen cannot be too weak, nor can it rise too quickly
The intervention also brings another risk, that is, the massive yen carry trade.

For a long time, the low-interest-rate yen has been used as a funding currency, and investors have borrowed yen to invest in high-yield currencies and assets. Once the yen rises rapidly, the financing cost will rise, and it may force the carry trade positions to be closed in large quantities, impacting global stocks, bonds, and other risk assets.
The case in August 2024 is a recent example, when the yen rose by about 10% in a short period, the Japanese stock market and global risk assets were severely shaken.
This intervention has driven the yen to rise by about 5%, and the market's current response is still relatively stable, but the subsequent trend still carries risks.

This has put the US and Japanese authorities in a dilemma: they cannot let the yen continue to depreciate, forcing Japan to sell US debt, and they also cannot let the yen rise too quickly, lest it trigger a chain of carry trade closures.
The real test will come after the midterm elections

The bigger problem is that this intervention has not solved the structural factors underlying the yen's weakness. Japan has maintained a long-term ultra-loose monetary policy, and there is a significant interest rate differential between Japan and the US, which is an important force in continuously depressing the yen.

At the same time, Japan's public debt-to-GDP ratio is high, and its fiscal space is limited, making it difficult for the Bank of Japan to promote policy normalization. If the Bank of Japan cannot continue to raise interest rates, and fiscal discipline has not improved, the yen may eventually face depreciation pressure again.

The real variable may come after the US midterm elections. If this intervention indeed has a political consideration to maintain market stability before the elections, whether the political will to push for joint protection after the elections will still exist will be a key factor.
At that time, if Japan's structural problems are still unresolved, and the effects of this intervention gradually wear off, the market may face even more severe pressure than it does now.
In other words, the yen may be stable temporarily, but the real pressure test may only come after the midterm elections.

items.title: 首款都還未發！蘋果折疊iPhone三代路線圖先曝光 傳內外雙螢幕最快2028年放大
items.title_en: Apple's First Foldable iPhone Not Yet Released, But Third-Generation Roadmap Leaked
paras: 蘋果首款折疊 iPhone 尚未亮相，但三代產品路線圖已先行曝光，知名科技記者古爾曼近日在《Power On》通訊中披露，蘋果已著手規劃第三代折疊 iPhone，最快 2028 年推出，新機內外雙螢幕尺寸都將比前兩代進一步放大。
按目前節奏，初代折疊 iPhone 預計下月登場，第二代定檔 2027 年，第三代最快 2028 年跟進，這是業界首次出現「第三代」具體時程爆料。
古爾曼指出，初代折疊 iPhone 外螢幕約 5.5 吋、內螢幕約 7.8 吋，第三代若繼續放大，整機可視面積將再上一階，但具體數字古爾曼未透露。
初代硬體輪廓同步浮現：超薄機身、捨棄 Face ID 改回 Touch ID、搭載 A20 晶片與自研 C2 基帶，命名可能叫「iPhone Ultra」，要價 2000 美元起跳。
蘋果第二代「Ultra 2」項目已獲准開發，螢幕方案很大機率沿用初代，預計 2027 年秋季與 iPhone 問世 20 週年紀念機同台，第三代折疊 iPhone 則是真正把「大螢幕體驗」再推一層的版本。
業內人士解讀，蘋果顯然不把折疊 iPhone 當單發試水產品。初代折疊 iPhone 重點是把書本式折疊形態、幾乎無摺痕與高耐久鉸鏈落地；二代延續方案、陪跑 20 週年紀念機；三代靠螢幕放大拉開代差。
供應鏈指出，蘋果近期已上調 2026、2027 年折疊機出貨預期，初代量產 7 月下旬啟動，市場正盯著 9 月發表會驗證「Ultra」定價與形態能否重洗高階手機格局。
paras_en: Apple's first foldable iPhone has yet to be released, but the roadmap for its third generation has been leaked. Renowned tech journalist Gurman recently revealed in his Power On newsletter that Apple has already begun planning its third-generation foldable iPhone, which is expected to be released as early as 2028. The new device will feature larger inner and outer screens compared to its predecessors.

Based on the current pace, the first-generation foldable iPhone is expected to debut next month, followed by the second generation in 2027, and the third generation as early as 2028. This is the first time a specific timeline for the third generation has been leaked.

Gurman noted that the first-generation foldable iPhone has an outer screen of approximately 5.5 inches and an inner screen of around 7.8 inches. If the third generation continues to increase in size, the overall visible area of the device will increase further, although Gurman did not disclose specific numbers.

The hardware design of the first generation has also been revealed: a super-thin body, the abandonment of Face ID in favor of Touch ID, the use of the A20 chip and a custom C2 baseband, and a possible name of "iPhone Ultra" with a starting price of $2,000.

Apple's second-generation "Ultra 2" project has been approved for development, and it is likely that the screen scheme will be similar to the first generation. The device is expected to be released in the fall of 2027, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of the iPhone.

Industry insiders interpret this as Apple not treating the foldable iPhone as a single test product. The first-generation foldable iPhone focused on implementing a book-like folding design, almost no creases, and high durability hinges. The second generation continued the scheme, while the third generation will rely on larger screens to create a wider price gap.

The supply chain has indicated that Apple has recently increased its expectations for foldable iPhone shipments in 2026 and 2027. The first-generation production is expected to start in late July, and the market is watching the September launch event to see if the "Ultra" pricing and design can shake up the high-end smartphone market.

items.title: 貝森特連出「3招」救長債！美債殖利率飆破5%  市場憂通膨、赤字成未爆彈
paras: 美債殖利率飆升正逼迫美國財政部出手應對。30 年期公債殖利率一度衝上 5.27%、創 19 年新高之際，美財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）近一週連出三招，從聯手日本干預日元、暗示可能縮減長債發行，到力挺聯準會主席華許，試圖壓抑長天期利率升勢。然而，在高通膨、巨額財政赤字與地緣政治風險等結構性壓力下，市場仍質疑這些政策工具究竟能否真正扭轉美債殖利率走高的趨勢。
摩根大通資產管理公司投資組合經理人 Priya Misra 指出，聯準會與財政部顯然都對長天期利率的走勢感到不安，而貝森特近期的種種操作，正是要向市場傳達財政部已經掌握利率動向、且不惜動用一切政策工具因應的訊號。
8 月 3 日，美日兩國財政部同步證實已聯手進場買進日元，是美國睽違 28 年再度出手干預日元匯率。
當天一張被媒體捕捉到的貝森特內閣會議筆記，意外洩漏了行動的來龍去脈。上頭寫著擬買進 50 億至 100 億美元日元的計畫。
然而外界分析，此舉的用意遠不止於「挺盟友」這麼單純。
日本是美國公債最大的海外持有國，持有部位超過 1.1 兆美元。一旦日本為籌措干預資金而被迫拋售美債，勢必進一步推升本已居高不下的美國長天期利率。
分析指出，這在 10 年期公債殖利率創下今年以來新高、30 年期更觸及近 20 年高點的當下，已從單純的理論疑慮，升級為政策必須正面回應的急迫課題。
值得留意的是干預手法本身。貝森特並未直接拋售美元換購日元，因為那將對美債殖利率造成立即衝擊，而是選擇透過賣出歐元、買進日元的迂迴方式完成操作，藉此避開對公債市場的直接影響。
研究機構 RSM 首席經濟學家 Joe Brusuelas 認為，具備避險基金背景的貝森特，看準了這個能同時壓低殖利率曲線、撐住美元並援助重要盟友的時機。
貝森特緊接著又拋出另一張牌：呼籲聯準會擴大「外國與國際貨幣當局附買回機制」的規模。這項機制讓外國央行得以其持有的美債作為擔保品借入美元，無需直接在市場上出售公債部位。
貝森特強調，相較於該機制在 2020 年設立時，如今公債市場規模已大幅膨脹，聯準會考慮擴大這項工具的規模有其合理性。
道富銀行資深總體策略師則認為，這項訊號的重要性甚至可能超越干預本身，因為它明確告訴市場：日本不必賣出美債也能取得美元流動性，等於是把日本手中的「籌碼」，從「拋售美債」切換成「抵押美債」，藉此斬斷日元走貶、美債遭拋售、殖利率被推升的連鎖反應。
紐約梅隆銀行總體策略師 John Velis 則提醒，鑑於目前的財政支出政策與地緣政治情勢，長期而言要緩解利率壓力恐怕相當困難。

鬆口減少長債標售 打破「只增不減」慣例

分析指出，如果說干預日元是貝森特打出的第一張牌，那麼財政部在季度再融資聲明中的措辭調整，影響可能更為深遠。
財政部在 8 月 6 日發布的聲明中，將關於未來附息公債標售規模的表述，由原本的「未來可能增加」，微調為「未來可能出現變化」。這是貝森特自 2025 年初上任以來，財政部首度在長天期公債發行政策上釋出鬆動跡象。
市場迅速將此解讀為財政部未來可能調降 20 年期與 30 年期公債標售規模的訊號。根據 BMO 資本市場調查，約 61% 受訪客戶預期 30 年期公債標售規模下一步的變化方向將是縮減而非擴大。
道明證券美國利率策略主管 Gennadiy Goldberg 認為，這樣的措辭轉變有助於緩和殖利率曲線長端的市場氣氛。
這項訊號打破了市場多年來對美債發行「只增不減」的既定認知。美國公債市場規模自 2018 年以來已翻倍成長至約 31 兆美元，在此背景下，供給端任何邊際上的調整都可能對長天期利率產生不小影響。
不過，德意志銀行策略師 Steven Zeng 也提醒，考慮到政府龐大的融資需求，削減長債發行恐怕並非財政部的基本劇本，這次措辭調整更可能只是為了暫時緩解市場對標售規模持續擴大的疑慮。

力挺華許 卻也埋下矛盾伏筆

貝森特布局的第三步，是公開為聯準會主席華許辯護。
7 月聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議後，華許拒絕就央行何時、如何壓低通膨給出明確指引，一度引發公債市場大舉拋售，市場也質疑其抑制通膨的信譽。
貝森特隨後在媒體上力挺華許，將這種溝通風格形容為一種讓金融市場與財經媒體擺脫對聯準會前瞻指引依賴的「戒斷」過程。
然而，這套方法本身存在明顯的內在矛盾。貝森特一方面試圖透過干預匯市、暗示減少長債供給等手段壓低長天期利率；另一方面，他所力挺的華許式「低調溝通」，恰恰可能是推升長天期利率的因素之一，因為市場因政策不確定性升高，往往會要求更高的期限溢酬作為補償。
瑞銀美國利率策略主管 Phoebe White 指出，財政部近期的一系列動作或許成效有限，但已充分顯示財政部有意動用一切可用工具，阻止長天期殖利率進一步走高。

結構性壓力遠超財政部工具箱

儘管貝森特的三重布局引發市場高度關注，實際效果仍受到嚴峻的結構性因素制約。
短期而言，在匯市干預與油價回落的雙重作用下，10 年期公債殖利率一度回落至 4.61%，但多數分析師認為政策效果有限，目前 30 年期殖利率仍維持在 5% 以上，10 年期也在 4.62% 左右徘徊。
首先是通膨的頑固性。美國通膨率已連續約五年高於聯準會設定的 2% 目標，公債投資人需要看到通膨真正受控的具體證據，才願意接受更低的殖利率。
法國巴黎銀行策略師指出，縮減長債標售雖是壓低殖利率為數不多的有效手段之一，但若財政部逐步、預告式地釋出訊號，恐將削弱政策突襲所能帶來的震撼效果。
其次是財政赤字規模龐大。美國政府每年新增近 2 兆美元赤字，勢必需要持續發行大量新債。德意志銀行認為，考慮到政府龐大的融資需求，削減長債發行並非基本情境；加拿大商業銀行策略師則更直言，縮減部分附息公債標售規模，目前根本尚未被納入政策選項之列。
第三則是地緣政治風險的衝擊。伊朗戰事推升的油價漲勢已引發新一波通膨疑慮，帶動 10 年期公債殖利率升至約 4.65%，高於川普第二任期開始時的水準。
加拿大帝國商業銀行策略師也警告，倘若為減少長天期公債供給而大幅增加短天期公債發行，恐怕也會因需要吸引更多買家而推升短端殖利率。
Onepoint Bfg 首席投資長 Peter Boockvar 示警：「隨著長天期利率走高，美國公債市場明顯已變得相當脆弱，我們也因此呼籲海外持有者不要拋售。」

items.title: AI記憶體超級週期拐點將至？三星、SK海力士DRAM漲幅不及高盛估算 美光下月財報恐補刀
items.title_en: Memory Super Cycle Turning Point Looms? Samsung, SK Hynix DRAM Growth Falls Short of Goldman Estimates, Micron's Q2 Earnings May Be a Knife in the Back
paras: AI 伺服器買盤瘋搶下，DRAM 與 NAND 快閃記憶體價格過去一年大幅飆漲，由三星、SK 海力士、美光壟斷的記憶體市場陷入嚴重缺貨，但隨著兩大韓廠最新季報揭露「漲價幅度不及預期」，市場開始擔心本輪超級週期是否已近獲利高點。
數據顯示，SK 海力士今年第二季 DRAM 均價上季仍漲約 30%、NAND 漲 50%；三星 DRAM 漲幅超 40%、NAND 漲 60%，絕對數字驚人，卻雙雙落後華爾街預期。
高盛原估 SK 海力士 DRAM 漲幅應達 39%，現將本季漲幅預測下修至 19%，晨星亦指三星 DRAM 漲幅低於其 48% 的估算，直言「失望」。
疲軟信號讓投資人警鈴大作。記憶體是典型週期股：新廠從動工到量產需數年，需求暴衝時價格飆升，一旦供給釋出或雲端資本開支降溫，價格回跌會放大利潤收縮。由於市場篤定獲利週期接近頂點，三星、SK 海力士、美光三巨頭股價仍被壓在個位數本益比。
更關鍵的是，合約價與現貨價出現裂口。HBM 與企業級 SSD 多走長約 (LTA)，部分產能提前鎖價，使混合 ASP 漲勢被稀釋，當季營收雖創新高，卻「不如最樂觀預期」，股價反應照例向下。
連鎖效應將燒向美光。分析師推測，美光下月公佈最新一季財報時，該公司 DRAM 定價同樣可能低於共識。短期來看，本季漲幅放緩已成基調，長期則看 2027 年供給若跟進、AI 資本開支邊際降速，本輪由 AI 堆出來的記憶體榮景，恐從「斜率放平」走向「獲利下修」。投資人押注的不該只是漲價延續，而是誰能在 LTA 護城河與自由現金流回饋上扛住向下趨勢。
paras_en: The AI server market has gone wild, driving up the prices of DRAM and NAND flash memory over the past year. The memory market, dominated by Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron, has become severely supply-constrained. However, with the latest quarterly reports from the two Korean companies revealing "growth rates below expectations," the market is starting to worry that the current super cycle may have reached its peak profit point.

Data shows that SK Hynix's DRAM average price rose by around 30% in the second quarter compared to the previous quarter, while NAND prices rose by 50%. Samsung's DRAM prices rose by over 40%, while NAND prices rose by 60%. These absolute numbers are impressive, but both companies fell short of Wall Street's expectations.

Goldman Sachs initially estimated that SK Hynix's DRAM prices would rise by 39%, but has now lowered its forecast to 19%. Morningstar also said that Samsung's DRAM price growth was lower than its 48% estimate, saying "disappointing".

The soft signals have triggered a warning bell for investors. Memory is a typical cyclical stock: it takes several years for a new factory to come online, and prices skyrocket when demand surges. Once supply is released or cloud capital expenditure cools down, prices will plummet, and profits will contract. Since the market has determined that the profit cycle is approaching its peak, the stock prices of Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron are still being held back by single-digit P/E ratios.

More importantly, the contract price and spot price have developed a gap. HBM and enterprise SSD have a long-term agreement (LTA), and some production capacity has been pre-priced, diluting the ASP growth. Although the season's revenue has set a new high, it "does not meet the most optimistic expectations," and the stock price has reacted downward as usual.

The chain effect will burn towards Micron. Analysts predict that Micron's latest quarterly earnings report next month will also show that the company's DRAM pricing will be lower than consensus. In the short term, the season's growth slowdown has become a trend, and in the long term, if supply follows in 2027 and AI capital expenditure margins slow down, the memory boom driven by AI will go from "slope flattening" to "profit reduction." Investors should not bet on continued price increases, but rather who can withstand the downward trend in LTA and free cash flow returns.

items.title: 日元只是暫時穩住 中期選舉後才是真正壓力測試
items.title_en: Yen Stabilizes Temporarily, Real Pressure Test to Come After Midterm Elections
paras: 美日聯手干預外匯市場後，日元近期暫時止跌回穩，但這場救市行動背後的目的，可能不只是穩定匯率。
前華爾街基金經理、宏觀分析師 Ed Dowd 認為，此次干預時點與美國中期選舉高度吻合，核心考量之一，是避免日元持續貶值迫使日本拋售逾 1 兆美元美債，進而推升美債殖利率，在政治敏感期引發金融市場與經濟動盪。
問題是，美日利差等結構性矛盾並未解決，一旦中期選舉落幕、政治護盤動力消退，日元能否守住目前水準，將成為下一階段市場焦點。
干預短期奏效 長期效果仍存疑
這波聯合干預已迅速反映在匯市。日元自 163.65 的低點回升至 159.09 附近，創下 2 月以來最大單週漲幅。美國財長貝森特（Scott Bessent）8 月 2 日也公開證實美日協調行動，並表明美方不會猶豫參與進一步的聯合干預。
不過，市場人士普遍認為，單靠外匯干預仍屬治標不治本。歷史經驗顯示，如果官方干預缺乏基本面政策配合，效果往往難以持久，且隨著干預次數增加，所需規模可能愈來愈大，邊際效果卻逐漸遞減。
Dowd 警告，如果日本政策沒有持續跟進，日元最終仍可能重新走弱，迫使當局採取規模更大、頻率更高的干預，而每一輪行動也會提高資產價格劇烈波動與流動性事件發生的風險。
救日元背後 更要防美債遭拋售
要理解這波干預的深層邏輯，關鍵在於日本持有大量美國國債。日本是美債最大境外持有國之一，持有規模超過 1 兆美元。當日元大幅貶值，日本當局為捍衛本幣，可能面臨動用外匯存底、出售美債的壓力，進而直接推升美債殖利率。
在美國財政赤字居高不下之際，美債殖利率若快速攀升，可能帶來更棘手的後果。因此，從這個角度來看，這次干預的直接導火線，更可能是日元貶值帶來的美債拋售風險，而非單純為日元護盤。
貝森特也援引亞洲金融危機經驗指出，日元極度疲弱可能產生外溢效應，因此與其等到危機爆發，不如提前採取行動。
路透報導，美國財政部在干預前已透過紐約聯準銀行通知多家銀行，要求隨時準備因應後續行動，也凸顯這次干預具有高度協調性。
FIMA 擴容 降低美債賣壓
此次行動另一項關鍵，在於貝森特明確支持擴大 FIMA（外國和國際貨幣當局）回購便利規模。
透過這項機制，日本等外國央行可以將持有的美國國債作為抵押，向聯準會取得美元流動性，不必直接把美債拋售至公開市場。
分析人士認為，這項安排等同透過美債換取美元，降低市場上的美債賣壓，進一步抑制殖利率上行壓力。
日元不能太弱 也不能升太快
干預也帶來另一項風險，那就是規模龐大的日元套利交易。
長期以來，低利率日元被大量用作融資貨幣，投資人借入日元後轉進高利率貨幣及資產。一旦日元快速升值，融資成本隨之攀升，可能迫使套利部位大規模平倉，進而衝擊全球股票、債券及其他風險性資產。
2024 年 8 月就是近期案例，當時日元短時間內升值約 10%，日本股市及全球風險資產隨即劇烈震盪。
這次干預已帶動日元升值約 5%，市場目前反應仍相對平穩，但後續走勢仍存在風險。
這也讓美日當局陷入兩難：既不能讓日元持續貶值，迫使日本出售美債；又不能讓日元升值太快，以免觸發套利交易連鎖平倉。
中期選舉後 真正考驗才開始
更大的問題在於，這次干預並未解決日元疲弱的結構性因素。日本長期維持超寬鬆貨幣政策，與聯準會之間存在明顯利差，這才是持續壓低日元的重要力量。
同時，日本公共債務占 GDP 比率高居全球前列，財政空間有限，也使日本央行推動政策正常化面臨諸多限制。如果日本央行無法持續升息、財政紀律又沒有明顯改善，日元最終仍可能重新面臨貶值壓力。
而真正的變數可能出現在美國中期選舉之後。若此次干預確實帶有維持選前市場穩定的政治考量，選舉結束後，推動美日聯手護盤的政治意願是否仍然存在，將成為關鍵。
屆時，若日本自身的結構性問題依舊未解，而這波干預帶來的效果逐漸消退，市場面對的壓力可能比現在更加嚴峻。
換言之，日元目前或許只是暫時穩住，真正的壓力測試，恐怕要等到中期選舉之後才會到來。
paras_en: After the US and Japan jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market, the yen has temporarily stabilized in recent times, but the purpose behind this rescue effort may not be just to stabilize the exchange rate.

Ed Dowd, a former Wall Street fund manager and macro analyst, believes that the timing of this intervention coincides with the US midterm elections, and one of the core considerations is to avoid a continuous depreciation of the yen forcing Japan to sell over $1 trillion in US debt, thereby pushing up US Treasury yields and causing financial market and economic turmoil in a politically sensitive period.

The problem is that the structural contradictions, such as the interest rate differential, have not been resolved, and once the midterm elections are over and the political protectionist momentum is lost, whether the yen can maintain its current level will become the next market focus.
The intervention has had a short-term effect, but its long-term effectiveness is still uncertain.

This joint intervention has quickly reflected in the market. The yen has risen from a low of 163.65 to around 159.09, creating a 2-month single-week gain. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent also publicly confirmed the US-Japan coordination action on August 2 and stated that the US will not hesitate to participate in further joint interventions.

However, market participants generally believe that relying solely on foreign exchange intervention is a palliative rather than a cure. Historical experience shows that if official intervention lacks basic policy support, the effect is often difficult to sustain, and as the number of interventions increases, the required scale may become larger, but the marginal effect will gradually decrease.

Dowd warned that if Japan's policies do not continue to follow up, the yen may eventually weaken again, forcing authorities to take larger-scale and more frequent interventions, and each round of action will increase the risk of asset price volatility and liquidity events.
The logic behind this rescue is not just to save the yen, but also to prevent US debt from being sold.

To understand the deeper logic of this intervention, the key lies in Japan's holding of a large amount of US debt. Japan is one of the largest foreign holders of US debt, with a holding size of over $1 trillion. When the yen depreciates sharply, the Japanese authorities may face pressure to use foreign exchange reserves and sell US debt, thereby directly pushing up US Treasury yields.

In a situation where the US fiscal deficit is high, if US Treasury yields rise rapidly, it may lead to more complicated consequences. Therefore, from this perspective, the direct trigger of this intervention is more likely to be the risk of US debt sales caused by yen depreciation, rather than simply protecting the yen.

Bessent also cited the experience of the Asian financial crisis, saying that a severely weak yen may have a spillover effect, so it's better to take action in advance rather than waiting for a crisis to break out.

Reuters reported that the US Treasury Department had notified several banks through the New York Federal Reserve before the intervention, asking them to be prepared for subsequent actions, highlighting the high degree of coordination of this intervention.
FIMA expansion reduces US debt selling pressure
Another key aspect of this action is that Bessent has explicitly supported the expansion of the FIMA (Foreign and International Monetary Authorities) repurchase facility.

Through this mechanism, foreign central banks, including Japan, can use US debt as collateral to obtain US dollars from the Federal Reserve, without having to sell US debt directly to the open market.

Analysts believe that this arrangement is equivalent to exchanging US debt for US dollars, reducing the selling pressure on US debt in the market, and further suppressing the upward pressure on yields.
The yen cannot be too weak, nor can it rise too quickly
The intervention also brings another risk, that is, the massive yen carry trade.

For a long time, the low-interest-rate yen has been used as a funding currency, and investors have borrowed yen to invest in high-yield currencies and assets. Once the yen rises rapidly, the financing cost will rise, and it may force the carry trade positions to be closed in large quantities, impacting global stocks, bonds, and other risk assets.
The case in August 2024 is a recent example, when the yen rose by about 10% in a short period, the Japanese stock market and global risk assets were severely shaken.
This intervention has driven the yen to rise by about 5%, and the market's current response is still relatively stable, but the subsequent trend still carries risks.

This has put the US and Japanese authorities in a dilemma: they cannot let the yen continue to depreciate, forcing Japan to sell US debt, and they also cannot let the yen rise too quickly, lest it trigger a chain of carry trade closures.
The real test will come after the midterm elections

The bigger problem is that this intervention has not solved the structural factors underlying the yen's weakness. Japan has maintained a long-term ultra-loose monetary policy, and there is a significant interest rate differential between Japan and the US, which is an important force in continuously depressing the yen.

At the same time, Japan's public debt-to-GDP ratio is high, and its fiscal space is limited, making it difficult for the Bank of Japan to promote policy normalization. If the Bank of Japan cannot continue to raise interest rates, and fiscal discipline has not improved, the yen may eventually face depreciation pressure again.

The real variable may come after the US midterm elections. If this intervention indeed has a political consideration to maintain market stability before the elections, whether the political will to push for joint protection after the elections will still exist will be a key factor.
At that time, if Japan's structural problems are still unresolved, and the effects of this intervention gradually wear off, the market may face even more severe pressure than it does now.
In other words, the yen may be stable temporarily, but the real pressure test may only come after the midterm elections.

paras: ◆USD/JPY

聖路易斯聯邦儲備銀行總裁穆薩萊姆加入其他美國聯邦準備理事會 (FED) 官員行列，認為 FED 上月應該升息，並隨著關於對荷姆茲海峽控制權交給伊朗的提議，削弱市場對迅速達成協議結束美國和伊朗衝突的樂觀預期，而且英國金融時報 (FT) 援引接近 FED 主席沃什的消息人士報導，依後續數據情況，9 月可能加息，推高美國公債收益率及支撐美元；此外，上週五日本數據顯示，截至 7 月底，外匯儲備降至 1.287 兆美元，並受天氣影響，6 月家庭支出意外較前月急跌 6.4%，且較去年同期降 3.3%，為連續第七個月下滑，而且 6 月同時指標與領先指標分別降至 0.3 及 0.0，令日圓承壓，推升美元兌日圓至 158.57 高點。

隨著日本政府退休金投資基金 (GPIF) 將公布 4-6 月績效，投資回報率料表現不俗，目前政府考慮賦予該基金更大投資彈性，並據日本財務省季度數據，4 月 30 日至 5 月 6 日期間，日本在外匯市場進行創紀錄單日干預達 6.28 兆日圓，共動用 400 億美元外匯儲備抑制日圓貶值，另外路透調查顯示，得益於強勁國內需求和進口下降抵消中東衝突帶來的不利影響，預計日本經濟在 4 月至 6 月期間實現連續第三個季度增長，而且日本放送協會 (NHK) 報導，日本財務大臣片山皋月表示若有必要，日本和美國將毫不猶豫再次干預外匯市場，限制日圓走貶；此外，美國勞工部公布 7 月失業率降至 4.1%，但非農業就業崗位意外減少 2.3 萬個，同時 5 月和 6 月就業崗位合計下修 10.3 萬個，而且 7 月平均時薪較前月增長 0.1% 遜於預期，促使利率期貨市場下調 FED 在 9 月加息的可能性，衝擊美元兌日圓跌至 157.01 低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於 158.00-20，支撐於 156.80-157.00。
◆EUR/USD
上週五據路透調查，澳洲央行 (RBA) 將於 8 月 11 日政策會議維持利率 4.35% 不變，今年餘下時間將按兵不動，相對市場預期 FED 於 9 月會議加息的機率為 55%，恐令澳幣面臨下行壓力，在美國就業數據前，澳幣和紐元停滯，歐元兌美元亦徘徊於 1.1516 低點。
隨後德國公布 6 月數據顯示，得益於汽車與運輸設備行業拉動，工業產出較前月增長 0.2%，為連續三個月增長，同時出口較上月連續五個月實現月度增長達 0.9%，進一步表明第二季經濟增長勢頭增強，而且美國就業數據不佳，降低 FED 加息的可能性，提振歐元兌美元至 1.1580 高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於 1.1520-40，阻力於 1.1600-20。
◆GBP/USD

傳聞葉門胡塞武裝與伊朗支持的伊拉克民兵組織可能發動一致的襲擊，令投資人對通過外交努力結束伊朗戰爭及恢復荷姆茲海峽通航持謹慎態度，而且上週五數據顯示 7 月 Lloyds 英國房屋價格分別較前月與上年同期降至持平及 0.1%，打壓英鎊兌美元至 1.3431 低點。隨著美國就業數據意外疲軟，降低 FED 加息的機率拖累美元，推升英鎊兌美元至 1.3508 高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於 1.3450-70，阻力於 1.3540-60。

paras_en: USD/JPY

Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis President James Bullard joined other Fed officials in saying the Fed should have raised rates last month. He also noted that a proposal to hand control of the Hormuz Strait to Iran weakens market optimism about a quick settlement of the U.S.-Iran conflict. The Financial Times, citing sources close to Fed Chair Jerome Powell, reported that, depending on upcoming data, a rate hike in September is possible, which could push U.S. Treasury yields higher and support the dollar. In addition, Japanese data released last Friday showed that foreign‑exchange reserves fell to $1.287 trillion at the end of July, and household spending in June unexpectedly dropped 6.4% from the previous month and 3.3% year‑on‑year – the seventh consecutive month of decline. June’s coincident and leading indicators fell to 0.3 and 0.0 respectively, putting pressure on the yen and lifting USD/JPY to a high of 158.57.

As Japan’s Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) prepares to publish its Q2 performance, expectations are that returns will be strong. The government is considering giving the fund greater investment flexibility. According to Ministry of Finance quarterly data, a record‑size single‑day FX intervention of ¥6.28 trillion was carried out between April 30 and May 6, using $40 billion of foreign‑exchange reserves to curb yen depreciation. Reuters surveys indicate that, thanks to robust domestic demand and lower imports offsetting the negative impact of Middle‑East tensions, Japan’s economy is expected to record its third consecutive quarter of growth for April‑June. NHK reported that Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki said Japan and the United States would not hesitate to intervene again in the FX market if necessary to limit yen weakness. Meanwhile, the U.S. Labor Department said the July unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, but non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs, and the May‑June job total was revised down by 103,000. July’s average hourly earnings rose only 0.1% month‑over‑month, below expectations, prompting rate‑futures traders to lower the probability of a September Fed hike and pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 157.01. The dollar‑yen pair is expected to face resistance around 158.00‑158.20 and support around 156.80‑157.00 today.
EUR/USD

Reuters reported last Friday that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) will keep its cash rate unchanged at 4.35% at the August 11 meeting and is likely to stay on hold for the rest of the year. The market’s probability of a Fed rate hike at the September meeting is about 55%, which could weigh on the Australian dollar. Ahead of U.S. jobs data, both the Aussie and the New Zealand dollar were flat, while the euro hovered near a low of 1.1516 against the dollar.

Germany released June data showing that industrial output rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, driven by the automotive and transport equipment sectors, marking a third consecutive month of growth. Exports also rose for the fifth straight month, up 0.9% from the previous month, indicating strengthening Q2 economic momentum. Poor U.S. employment figures reduced expectations of further Fed tightening, lifting the euro to a high of 1.1580 against the dollar. The euro‑dollar pair is expected to find support around 1.1520‑1.1540 and face resistance near 1.1600‑1.1620 today.
GBP/USD

Rumors that Yemen’s Houthi forces and Iran‑backed Iraqi militias may launch coordinated attacks have made investors cautious about diplomatic efforts to end the Iran war and reopen the Hormuz Strait. Data released last Friday showed that July Lloyds Housing Prices in the UK were flat month‑over‑month and down 0.1% year‑over‑year, pushing the pound to a low of 1.3431 against the dollar. The unexpected weakness in U.S. jobs data lowered the odds of a Fed hike, dragging the dollar lower and lifting the pound to a high of 1.3508. The pound‑dollar pair is expected to find support around 1.3450‑1.3470 and face resistance near 1.3540‑1.3560 today.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美非農就業人口意外減少 美元周線連二黑
items.title_en: New York Foreign Exchange Market: US Non-Farm Employment Population Decreases, Dollar Falls for Second Consecutive Week
paras: 美元對主要貨幣周五 (7 日) 走軟，美國 7 月非農就業人口意外減少，引發市場對美國經濟韌性的擔憂，也削弱了聯準會 (Fed) 升息的理由，進而拖累美元。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣走勢的 ICE 美元指數 (DXY) 下跌 0.44%，約報 99.50，本周共下跌 0.31%，連續第二周走軟。
美國勞工部公布，7 月非農就業人數減少 2.3 萬人，與路透調查經濟學家預期增加 8 萬人大相逕庭。美國失業率則降至 4.1%，但勞動參與率下滑至 61.4%，創近 5 年半低點。
就業報告公布後，美元兌日元貶值 0.57% 至 157.56 日元，但本周仍升值約 0.10%。由於美日當局上周聯合進行歷史性干預，美元兌日元一度跌至 13 周低點。
歐元兌美元上揚 0.39%，報 1.1568 美元，本周升值 0.41%。
美元走弱反映市場對 Fed 升息的預期降溫。根據芝商所 (CME) FedWatch 工具，市場目前預期 Fed 在 9 月維持利率不變的機率為 56%，高於前一日的 45%。
Macquarie Group 全球外匯及利率策略師 Thierry Wizman 說：「我認為，沒有人真的預期非農就業人數會出現負值，也沒有人預期 6 月就業數據會大幅下修。」
他進一步解釋：「我傾向認為，市場已將 Fed 升息時點從 9 月延後至 10 月或 12 月。每當數據顯示美國經濟疲弱，或勞動市場沒有原先認為的那麼強勁，市場就會把 Fed 升息的可能時點往後推。」
美國公債殖利率在就業報告公布後大幅下滑。通常追隨 Fed 利率預期走勢的 2 年期美債殖利率下跌 4.2 個基點，報 4.245%，基準的 10 年期美債殖利率下跌 2 個基點，報 4.649%。

paras_en: The US dollar softened against major currencies on Friday as the US non-farm employment population unexpectedly decreased in July, sparking concerns about the resilience of the US economy and weakening the case for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike, which in turn dragged down the dollar.

At the close of the New York market, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar's movement against six major currencies, fell 0.44% to around 99.50, marking a 0.31% decline for the week and its second consecutive weekly drop.

The US Labor Department reported that non-farm employment decreased by 23,000 in July, contrary to the expected increase of 80,000 predicted by Reuters' survey of economists. The US unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, but the labor participation rate slid to 61.4%, a near 5.5-year low.

Following the release of the employment report, the dollar depreciated 0.57% against the yen to 157.56 yen but still appreciated about 0.10% for the week. The dollar-yen exchange rate had hit a 13-week low after the US and Japanese authorities conducted a historic intervention the previous week.
The euro rose 0.39% against the dollar to $1.1568, marking a 0.41% gain for the week.

The dollar's weakness reflects a cooling of expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently sees a 56% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September, up from 45% the previous day.

Thierry Wizman, a global foreign exchange and interest rate strategist at Macquarie Group, said, 'I think nobody really expected the non-farm payroll to be negative, and nobody expected the June employment numbers to be revised downward significantly.'

He further explained, 'I tend to think the market has pushed back the timing of the Fed's rate hike from September to October or December. Whenever the data shows the US economy is weaker or the labor market is not as strong as previously thought, the market pushes back the potential timing of the rate hike.'

US Treasury yields plummeted after the employment report was released. The 2-year Treasury yield, which typically tracks Fed rate expectations, fell 4.2 basis points to 4.245%, while the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield dropped 2 basis points to 4.649%.
